Now, I'm asking for you to help my friend make it to the top of the hill this time around | Fellow patriot, Democrats love to virtue signal non-stop, and cancel anyone who disagrees with them. For the longest time, it worked. But now, conservatives know the Left’s game, and how to beat it. The key is to be PROUD of our beliefs, ignore the liberal attacks, and tell everyday working-class Americans what we believe -- and how our principles make their lives better. Now, we’re seeing Republicans of all stripes filing to run for office, saying what’s on their mind, and defending our shared beliefs. Let me be clear: The Republican Party welcomes anyone who shares our values. My friend Monica De La Cruz knows that, too. In 2020, Monica De La Cruz fell short just 6,588 votes from winning a seat in Congress that has been held by Democrats for over 100 years. Had she been successful, Monica would have been the first Hispanic Republican ever elected to Congress from South Texas. Will you please to help me end 120 years of Democrats holding the congressional seat she's currently running for? I encouraged Monica to try again – a 6,000 vote deficit is easily overcome with the right message and enough support. . Monica has set a personal goal of raising $15,000 before October 9th, and I’ve pledged to do all that I can to help her realize her goal. We need more people like Monica in Congress; she is living proof of the American Dream. She knows that in America, when you set your mind to something you can achieve it. She was raised by a single mother in a Texas border town, despite the hardships, Monica struck out on her own to realize her own American Dream. Armed with her faith and support from her Mother, Monica grew up to become one of the top insurance agents in South Texas. We need people like Monica in Congress. A woman who knows what hard work is; a woman who has the perseverance and grit to deliver for her community. Republicans only need to pick up FIVE seats next year to win back the House, and I can tell you that Monica’s race is one of the best chances we have at flipping a BLUE seat RED! On behalf of my friend Monica, – whatever that means to you. Monica will represent our entire Party in the House, and she’ll make us all proud. body:

#
A few weeks ago, our team sat down with Ana Rodriguez — the mother of 10-year old Maite Yuleana Rodriguez who was tragically killed in Uvalde.
Ana wanted to share her story because she never wants another family to have to go through this. Her video is incredibly powerful — and you may have already seen it on the airwaves.
[**We hope you take a minute to watch Ana’s video here, and then if you’re able to, please pitch in $3 to get it in front of more Texans so everyone hears Ana’s story and joins us in taking action to elect a governor who will reduce gun violence.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20221010-3.I-FXEe&refcode=ema20221010-211923&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=211923%2E444211%2EyexYQ3)

There’s a big reason why so many family members from Uvalde recently announced their support for Beto. Greg Abbott has done nothing to prevent the next mass shooting at a time when gun violence is now the leading cause of death for kids and teens in Texas.
There have been six major mass shootings on Abbott’s watch, and **_not one law_** has been passed to stop this violence in the 19 weeks since Uvalde. **The inaction must end now.**
Beto will be a governor who moves forward on the popular, bipartisan, and commonsense steps that are needed to reduce gun violence — from passing universal background checks and implementing red flag laws, to raising the minimum age for purchasing an assault weapon from 18 to 21.
**We must make sure that all Texans know what is at stake in this election, and that we can elect a governor who will finally put our kids’ lives above the NRA or any special interest.**

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

I really don't reach out often, which is how you know this is critically important. I'll be short, though.

Here are the facts:
1. Marco Rubio has been outraised Five Quarters in a row.
2. Marco's opponent, Val Demings, is financially backed by Nancy Pelosi and Chuck Schumer.
3. Poll after poll after poll shows this race is tied.
4. The media is saying Marco's in the fight of his career, and he's never seen a race as tough as this.
5. His opponent has spent over $40 million spreading lies about him, and Marco can't keep up.
6. If Marco loses, we will not be able to take back the Senate and get our country back.

******[DEFEND MARCO RUBIO >>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61586040:6dw184VNP:m:1:3253819041:5644F8D2F3EBB6BA04E25E0EB1FB3010:r)******

******[LET 'S SAVE AMERICA TOGETHER >>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61586040:6dw184VNP:m:1:3253819041:5644F8D2F3EBB6BA04E25E0EB1FB3010:r)******

Before I got into politics, I thought you had to write big checks to make a difference. But now, let me tell you, any dollar can make a difference in a race like this that's tied. If you're staying on the sidelines because you think you don't matter, that's just not true!

You have the power to decide what happens next. _You have two choices:_
1. Accept that the Democrats have won, and we can't get our country back on track.
2. [**We can work together to save our country and take back control from the Democrats. **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61586040:6dw184VNP:m:1:3253819041:5644F8D2F3EBB6BA04E25E0EB1FB3010:r)

If you don't donate because you think it doesn't matter, I really hope you reconsider. If you can't donate because you can't afford to, know that I understand, and I appreciate you taking the time to read this.

I appreciate you,
Dr. Ben Carson

---
Fellow Conservative: The fight for the United States Senate this November is going to come down to Wisconsin — and my close friend and ally, Senator Ron Johnson. If you have followed politics in the last few years, you know that few, if any, in Congress have been more passionate or effective leaders. No one has done more to expose the Left’s Covid lies. No one has fought harder to seal our borders, protect our children, and preserve the integrity of our elections. **Ron Johnson does what he says he will do. He took an oath to support and defend the Constitution – and he works hard to do that in the Senate every day.** **[Please help build a conservative Senate by supporting Ron Johnson in Wisconsin today!](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zj7dcvtb6jqf5p992adnlaif2jaga9mcub0b3828_rp22sh2s8i66or5c5ge4ob4s1h2bs)** It doesn't matter where you live. Senate races are national elections that affect the lives of all Americans. The Left knows how important this race is, which is why everyone on their side – from the media to Big Tech to the Democrats’ political machine — is pouring millions into Wisconsin to destroy Ron Johnson.
---
---
But it’s also why I’m traveling to Wisconsin to campaign for him. And I’m not coming empty-handed. I'm working with Senate Conservatives Fund to bundle contributions for his campaign from freedom-loving Americans across the nation. **[Please join me in this effort by making a donation to Ron Johnson's Senate campaign.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zgash5n6kqp4qhd0c1uaguc6pebkmlk3j506g61o_rp22sh2s8i66or5c5ge4ob4s1h2bs)** _SCF will pay all processing fees and transfer 100% of your donation directly to his campaign. You can also support their other endorsed candidates at the same time and help give Ron Johnson much-needed conservative reinforcements in the Senate._ **Conservatives cannot afford to lose this race, so please take action now – before it's too late.** Conservatives can’t win races like this with blank checks from New York billionaires and San Francisco millionaires. It takes bottom-up support from everyone: ▶︎ Every family ravaged by Bidenflation;
▶︎ Every town buckling under Biden’s crime wave;
▶︎ Every parent labeled a terrorist;
▶︎ Every voice silenced by woke Big Tech censors; and
▶︎ Every American who still believes in the right to life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness. I’m fighting liberals in Washington, and I'm campaigning for conservative victory on November 8. But I can’t do it alone. We can only win this fight together. **[Please join the fight. Join me in supporting Wisconsin Senator Ron Johnson today!](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zr8otu9bmr12nbfta5a4nhqt06ua8erha3sv1r5o_rp22sh2s8i66or5c5ge4ob4s1h2bs)** Thank you for considering this urgent request and for doing so much to help fight for America's future. Sincerely,
---
---
JIM JORDANU.S. Congressman, R-Ohio

---
**SUPPORT RON JOHNSON FOR SENATE**
---
---
Few leaders in Congress have done more than Ron Johnson in the last few years to fight for the truth and freedom. Johnson was an early leader on the need for effective early Covid treatments. The media and the Democrats laughed, but now many have been forced to agree with him! He led Congress’s most vigorous investigation of Hunter Biden and the corruption inherent in his “family business." And he has fought back against the false media narratives about the January 6 riot and asks the right questions about what the FBI knew, and when they knew it. Ron Johnson is a courageous leader and we need him back in the Senate next year!

Dear Fellow Conservative, I know you’ve been paying attention so I’m sure you’ve seen the consequences across our country of allowing Leftist bureaucrats and their corporate lackeys to abuse their power completely unchecked. But I’ll quickly remind you of the growing list...inflation continues to soar, our southern border is in chaos, the Biden family is corrupt in plain sight, schools have become centers for Marxist indoctrination and transgender recruitment, and our domestic energy sources are being gutted in favor of green-energy boondoggles. And if they aren’t confronted now, the Left will complete their plan of remaking our republic into a totalitarian state where personal liberty and freedom of expression are both things of the past. **The Radical Left is using the power of the administrative state to execute their unpopular agenda and further centralize power in Washington. And now they are using federal agencies as their own secret police to punish any and all opposition**. You’ve already seen how far the left will go with their raid of Mar-a-Lago and most recently of a pro-life activist in Pennsylvania. So just imagine what they’re planning to do with the _87,000_ new IRS agents they plan to hire. **To make matters worse:** the Radical Left has complete control of Washington. The mainstream media and Big Tech back them every step of the way. If we don’t put an end to this outrageous abuse of power, no one else will. **[The time to act is now!](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2g5obgn9pto3di4sosk4ar6u57ub173rehmh4g8_rp22sh2s8i66or5c5geeo74c5h2bs) ** To fight on your behalf, The Heritage Foundation has launched our most aggressive investigative initiative to date—** _The Heritage Oversight Project_** —to hold this regime accountable for intentionally subverting our republic and its rule of law. This new special project will unleash the full investigative powers of The Heritage Foundation and our multimedia news organization, The Daily Signal, to expose the collusion of the leftist regime and provide aggressive oversight to protect the rights of hardworking Americans like you. **We are using strategic FOIAs, lawsuits, information leaks, and our network of contacts in Congress and in government to target and expose the actions and agendas of Leftist political and corporate leaders. ** Armed with evidence uncovered from our investigations, we will then work with lawmakers at the state and federal levels to use subpoena power—and the power of the gavel—**to confront whatever and _whomever_ the project exposes.** **But to do this critical work while maintaining our regular legislative efforts, we need to raise $2.3 million this month to fund this special project. ** If you’d like to stand with other conservative leaders who are ready to take down Biden’s Radical Regime, you can join this critical fight by making a gift using the secure link below now: **[https://secured.heritage.org/oversight-project/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zsbgemu834i2fs9cmd4t237kh736iha4voibolu0_rp22sh2s8i66or5c5geeo74c5h2bs)** This is your chance to combine forces with other patriots to unleash the full investigative, legislative, and media power of The Heritage Foundation, The Daily Signal, and our powerful partners in Washington to fight on your behalf. Can we count on your support to see this fight through to the end? Make your tax-deductible gift using the secure link now: **[https://secured.heritage.org/oversight-project/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zgb24rrsfcpjgnqpggnl8c4gunrg5f144tmecps8_rp22sh2s8i66or5c5geeo74c5h2bs)** Sincerely, Mike Howell Conservative Oversight Project Director

Dear Friend,
We are getting down to the wire and Caroline needs your help. Our campaign is making it easy for volunteers to help get out the vote. There is more than one way to help. You can do it from the comfort of your own home.
We will be conducting 2 trainings this week for those who wish to volunteer. You can decide how you want to help.
Training is less than one hour. All Training is in Stoneham.

Training #1 : Wednesday October 12th at 5:30 pm Training # 2: Saturday October 15th at 5:00 pm
Where: 4 Patrick Circle Stoneham, MA
Please indicate in the RSVP email box above which training you will attend including your full name and address. It is simple training and you will be surprised how much you can do from home that will make a huge difference. You must RSVP in advance.
We are excited to get out voters who are fed up with a complicit Congress and DC politicians who are not serving the people who elected them.
We need people to write letters to the editor. This is very important as it reaches voters and draws attention to current issues and the campaign. I can provide you clear instructions and help provide you contact information for local news outlets.
We need people to hold signs. Click the links above to get involved. Election Day is 28 days away and there's no time like the present to bring about the change we want and need in District 5.

name: Jacky Rosen
subject: the powerful Jewish principle of Tikkun Olam
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rosen for Nevada
body:
Friend, I wanted to follow up to make sure you saw my email below because it's about something near and dear to me: my faith.
---
I couldn't be prouder to be the granddaughter of Jewish immigrants. From hard work to persistence, the values that my family taught me guide everything I do to serve you in the Senate. **But the value I carry with me most of all is the powerful Jewish principle of Tikkun Olam, which means to repair and improve the world.**
If there's ever been a moment in our lifetime when we needed to come together to do our part in repairing the world, that moment is now.
**So in the face of everything from growing antisemitism to attacks on our most fundamental rights, I hope I can count on you to stand with me in the fight for progress.** **[Please, chip in $5 or more today to help me continue fighting in the Senate for the issues that matter most](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52375415/372057544/610767770?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2082-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNmUzM2FhMS01ZDQ5LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HOY_ovIdewcsBe_YQbF3evv-lDAEvDOESty7ISIZ98g=)****[.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52375416/372057545/610767770?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2082-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNmUzM2FhMS01ZDQ5LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HOY_ovIdewcsBe_YQbF3evv-lDAEvDOESty7ISIZ98g=)**
Thanks so much,

Jacky
\---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: **Jacky Rosen**
Date: Mon, Oct 10, 2022
Subject: I am the proud granddaughter of Jewish immigrants.
| | |
---
Friend, my work in the Senate is guided by the timeless and powerful Jewish principle of Tikkun Olam – which means to repair and improve the world. So today, I want to take just a moment to share a little bit more about my faith with you.
I am the proud granddaughter of Jewish immigrants. From a young age, my family taught me the values of hard work, determination, and persistence – and I learned how Jewish women have been holding our communities together and taking a stand against injustice from the time of the Torah to today.
Now, as both the third Jewish woman Senator in U.S. history and the only former synagogue president in the U.S. Senate, **I'm proud to carry these values with me in everything I do to serve Nevada and our country.**
And in this present moment, we're facing no shortage of issues – many of which directly impact women and the Jewish community. From growing antisemitism to attacks on abortion rights, to attacks on our very democracy, I know it's my duty to respond with clear resolve and a commitment to social justice.
If we truly want to repair the world, then it’s up to all of us to come together, roll up our sleeves, and do the repairing.

subject: I never take a dime of corporate PAC money
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Andy Kim for Congress
body:
I'm proud to be endorsed by End Citizens United, a group working to end dark money in politics and strengthen voting rights. I represent the people of New Jersey, not corporations.

That's why I don't take a dime of corporate PAC money. I rely on grassroots support from people like you. And in a tough race like this one, every dollar matters. Can you give $4 today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/stand-with-andy-kim?refcode=2022-10-11-ecu&recurring=0&amount=4&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=f59146c2-6449-ed11-b495-002248258d38]

Since the 2010 Citizens United decision opened the floodgates, dark money groups have spent billions of dollars to pollute our elections with misleading attack ads, dirty hit-piece mailers, and vast amounts of disinformation.

Because it's dark money, we don't know who's funding these groups or why. And there's no way to hold anyone accountable for the dishonesty – or even to engage them in a debate. We can't have a civil political discussion if the other side is hiding.

And make no mistake: that's just the way some people want it. The hiding is the point.

Most folks don't believe that the super wealthy and massive corporate interests should be able to use money as an invisibility cloak. A recent poll found that 90% of voters want to end dark money in politics by making contributions more transparent. Yet just a couple of weeks ago, Senate Republicans voted down legislation that would do exactly that.

I will never give up on our democracy and the principle that the people should have the power. So, I'm leading the charge to get dark money out of politics.

But, I'm in a tough race this year. Dark money groups are spending buckets of money to elect my right-wing opponent. Plus, he's drawing from a huge inheritance to fund his campaign. I'm relying on people like you to send me back to Congress. Can you chip in $4 today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/stand-with-andy-kim?refcode=2022-10-11-ecu&recurring=0&amount=4&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=f59146c2-6449-ed11-b495-002248258d38]

Our grassroots democracy is on the ballot this year. We must work together to protect it.

Andy

The last 4 weeks of this election are going to get intense

**Derek, there are only four weeks left till Election Day.** Time’s running out to make sure that we win on November 8th — to make sure that our freedoms, our rights, and our futures are protected from Doug Mastriano. I’m going to break down what the next four weeks of the campaign will look like, but first I have to be honest with you. My team told me that we’re falling behind on our online fundraising projections — and we need to make that money up ASAP if we want to stay ahead in this fight. So I’m asking: **[Will you start a weekly donation today to support this campaign in our last four weeks?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52379565/372074259/-586780698?refcode=email_101122_4weeks_allactive&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ODNmMTQxZS02NzQ5LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V6tJSI1fSIkmwlXlxFgeSMU75GYoNXt4dgyU9xkmLXA=)** Here’s what the next four weeks are going to look like: 4 weeks to go: We’re focused on getting our message out to every Pennsylvanian — regardless of their party identification or voting history. Our team will be going full force — running ads, knocking doors, and texting voters to make sure that everyone is able to cast a ballot on November 8th. 2 weeks to go: Our team will take a look at who’s already cast a ballot, who needs to return theirs, and who we can still persuade to support this campaign. We’ll use that information to launch the last phase of our data-driven voter outreach efforts and get ready for the final week. 1 week to go: We’re making our final, closing argument to Pennsylvania voters and why it’s so important that they cast a ballot in this race. subject: Josh Riley is is a good man, who cares about making the government work for families like yours. He’s running for one of the most strategically important House races in the country. Let me tell you a little bit about him.
body:
Dear Person Who Still Opens My Email,
I hardly ever ask anything of you. Unless you’re also on my other list of people who I constantly ask to contribute to something I don’t think I can legally mention here. (Though it’s a really good thing.)
I want you to give to Josh Riley’s campaign for the open House in seat in NY’s 19th district. And to CommonGood too. Please donate now! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_riley?refcode==20221011_CGVA_Riley]
Josh was my Judiciary Committee counsel, and I cannot say enough good things about him. But here’s some.
Josh grew up in the district in a working-class neighborhood of Endicott, NY.
After graduating from Harvard Law School, Josh moved to Florida to work on a landmark civil rights lawsuit representing kids from low-income families who were having difficulty accessing the healthcare services they needed.
Josh really, really cares about all the stuff I care about.
Josh is the hardest worker I know.
Together we passed bills expanding rights for survivors of domestic abuse and providing new funding for addiction treatment and mental health programs.
We also made a lot of Republican witnesses look very bad. Josh is my friend.
And finally, this open seat is considered one of the most competitive in the nation.

Control of the House is up for grabs. Please help Josh win this one for all of us.
This is important. To me. And to our nation.
Thanks,
Al

Hi Friend, I'm excited to share Country First's "Defenders of Democracy" endorsement slate -- something I've put a lot of thought into as we approach the 2022 mid-term general elections. | [](https://www.country1st.com/endorsed?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=endorse22_nd&n=2 "See Country First's 2022 Endorsements") [See Country First's 2022 Endorsements](https://www.country1st.com/endorsed?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=endorse22_nd&n=2)
---
Let me tell you what this slate is, and what it isn't.
This slate IS as unique and politically diverse as our movement, and includes Republicans, Independents, AND Democrats.
This slate IS NOT an exhaustive list of every candidate we think is good or race we think is important. We can only focus on so many in this final stretch, so I narrowed it down to these dozen Democracy Defenders.
This slate IS weighted toward state races, particularly those in which the victor will play an important role in executing a free, fair, and lawful 2024 presidential election in battleground states.
This slate IS NOT an endorsement of any candidate's personal policy views or platform. I believe these to be reasonable people of goodwill who will defend our democracy -- and at this point in time, that matters more to me than the letter after their name.
[>> So let me introduce you to our Democracy Defenders on our website.](https://www.country1st.com/endorsed?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=endorse22_nd&n=3)
Country First will be boldly supporting each of these candidates with a tailored investment plan that echoes the winning strategy we employed in the primaries: Fundraising, advertising, texting, grassroots activating, and getting out the vote. We're proud to do our part, and hope you'll consider [investing](https://www.country1st.com/endorsed?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=endorse22_nd&n=4) in our slate here, too.
If you'd rather show your support with our new Country First signs, athletic wear, or signed hats, head on over to the [shop](https://www.country1st.com/shop?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=endorse22_nd&n=5), and all proceeds will go toward our important work.
Finally. stay tuned for an update from me on the 1/6 Committee after Thursday's hearing. I know you won't want to miss it.
Thank you for your support and for bringing our movement to life. Let's do this.
Country First,
Adam

subject: This is my story
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Laxalt for Senate
body:
Will you help me continue it?

| |
---
| | | Friend, my name is Adam Laxalt. You may have never heard of me, so I wanted to take a moment to tell you a bit about why I’m running for U.S. Senate in Nevada.

I was born in Reno, Nevada and raised by a single mother. Growing up, it was just me and my mom. I have always aspired to be as much of a leader as she was.

---
| [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=775eb675e59e422d9d72311a149f4e4c&_e=rgFs2wA9_a8B2RoarqJMIcx25s2qJfdWiVEcbsKuNLSxExqaDyxYMW-nxcLsbRaqbIJLCQ3fMyfRSqzIx-14PkDffxs2Reizt0W_qbXEYUCwMKciNwW2OXIt_D9pezQXjVdJX1dKUZZYcJ-n3lSEQuvKUp5DHJ6CcrGwSsarEZ8qHdOycLW_zYugzaYc4VqzguWbG2kIcKhi6MqZa12s78B8Q7__U_P7FzPjTW1FlqSD_Ej_6jTLRkUF_H6JQFW3orcweYBqSfO2CZkiCsg6Dnvb3IWaJUREOnBChOyUUKUGmIQW2QkRa_5F6gfHg1x-RUlra_SCjqCBRLmjsDTI8RUYTtK8DSMOI2Yy7K5Og9qBEsHPsR0Gn4_wAsevnSbX8S_MUV-9MHQ-dRjpMmVi6cY2Uj-wfygIEB8xcM-XzLY%3D "Adam 1")
---

I know that real leadership means standing up for what you believe in and standing up for people everywhere. But I was headed down the wrong path in life.

As a teenager, I suffered from addiction. But the people who loved me got me help. I turned my life around, and that taught me helping others gives life meaning. That’s why I volunteered to serve in the Navy after 9/11 and volunteered to serve in the Iraq War.

---
| | | [SUPPORT ADAM LAXALT](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=775eb675e59e422d9d72311a149f4e4c&_e=rgFs2wA9_a8B2RoarqJMIcx25s2qJfdWiVEcbsKuNLSxExqaDyxYMW-nxcLsbRaqbIJLCQ3fMyfRSqzIx-14PkDffxs2Reizt0W_qbXEYUCwMKciNwW2OXIt_D9pezQXjVdJX1dKUZZYcJ-n3lSEQuvKUp5DHJ6CcrGwSsarEZ8qHdOycLW_zYugzaYc4VqzguWbG2kIcKhi6MqZa12s78B8Q7__U_P7FzPjTW1FlqSD_Ej_6jTLRkUF_H6JQFW3orcweYBqSfO2CZkiCsg6Do1PpFqoRs60GJEkJ9ob-Zo7sbgqlSdI_SIItMRrDqKTLkSlIm2VEVAE8k8yNwYXv9iBrvBzdlMi2Rgxes2-W7DIZg5SRybaPq1dx2_0o0g_nqZJ0dkZTB-WDYIuTVjhqG40hY6r-R8Ru4plsPWPeeQ%3D "SUPPORT ADAM LAXALT")
---

Serving our country as a Navy Officer in Iraq was an honor.

While I was serving, my unit was in charge of over 20,000 detainees to keep American troops safe. This was one of the most challenging experiences of my life, but also the most rewarding.

_Knowing that I was on the front lines of protecting the country I love so dearly is something that I will continue to cherish for the rest of my life._

---
| [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=775eb675e59e422d9d72311a149f4e4c&_e=rgFs2wA9_a8B2RoarqJMIcx25s2qJfdWiVEcbsKuNLSxExqaDyxYMW-nxcLsbRaqbIJLCQ3fMyfRSqzIx-14PkDffxs2Reizt0W_qbXEYUCwMKciNwW2OXIt_D9pezQXjVdJX1dKUZZYcJ-n3lSEQuvKUp5DHJ6CcrGwSsarEZ8qHdOycLW_zYugzaYc4VqzguWbG2kIcKhi6MqZa12s78B8Q7__U_P7FzPjTW1FlqSD_Ej_6jTLRkUF_H6JQFW3orcweYBqSfO2CZkiCsg6DjIDLuRUshpBDqFXEJVhakxF_IRPs-oIrdD123JhsN3-k0dDIjayKvoH53j892DVPlrtUT2gPYYdyWdc2O87CwqwF1uH1o_lImqT8DhfvJrm04jlPU-2_RoreBQQnjGrtXcbEe1liSGpPFSc6szcjO4%3D "Adam 2")
---

After returning from Iraq, I felt the call to serve my state again and went on to be Nevada’s Attorney General and top law enforcement officer. I fought hard to serve the people of Nevada, where I fought against President Obama by suing over federal overreach. I fought for the Constitution.

Now I'm taking on a huge challenge for our country: running for U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=775eb675e59e422d9d72311a149f4e4c&_e=rgFs2wA9_a8B2RoarqJMIcx25s2qJfdWiVEcbsKuNLSxExqaDyxYMW-nxcLsbRaqbIJLCQ3fMyfRSqzIx-14PkDffxs2Reizt0W_qbXEYUCwMKciNwW2OXIt_D9pezQXjVdJX1dKUZZYcJ-n3lSEQuvKUp5DHJ6CcrGwSsarEZ8qHdOycLW_zYugzaYc4VqzguWbG2kIcKhi6MqZa12s78B8Q7__U_P7FzPjTW1FlqSD_Ej_6jTLRkUF_H6JQFW3orcweYBqSfO2CZkiCsg6Dn3haG5dJrrQydWfEo3_8yJjeeBiMa8mp0TQZX5Q_LmQfRBsbuu2iPoYGF3BslccXM-_IxzHTdx3EHQwQLeI0mr1xD3Xs9b7IZTmdtieGQgWkVWTV_LFRy38z5WrIx1peeNT3tOahsgPEP7-EwnAORo%3D "Adam 3")
---

My race is **officially the #1 race in the country** , and all eyes are on me. The Democrats have already raised 76 MILLION to destroy my campaign.

subject: Proof that Hollywood is Satanic
body:
_Proof that Hollywood is Satanic_[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61580705:6tunW4VyN:m:1:3339843426:3E8B2A8A91A3A0156D051589A27A6720:r)
Peter,

Would you believe me if I said that a mother watched videos of her daughter having sex with her boyfriend and picked which one her daughter looked best in to **sell?**

Because that's exactly what happened -- Kris Jenner watched AND hand-picked which sex tape her daughter Kim Kardashian would release!

**It is not an exaggeration to say that Hollywood is satanic.**
What could possibly be more satanic than a mother using her daughter's body to sell sex?

If that disgusts you, here's where it gets worse. _It worked_. Kim Kardashian is a billionaire, and she's still selling sex.

She is symbolic of the society we live in today. That if you are willing to degrade yourself, if you're willing to denigrate yourself, then our society will give you more.

**Is this the example we want to leave for our children?**

At BLEXIT, we believe families should be grounded in faith and honor and respect their children and protect their innocence.

My name is Candace Owens, co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation. BLEXIT focuses on educating minorities about the history of our great country, the principles of the Constitution, and the importance of self-reliance.

I've set a goal to raise $50,000 by the end of the month to show the next generation that they don't have to be like the Kardashians to be successful.

[**Can you support this critical mission with a gift of $25, $35, or even $50? Click here to donate today >>>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61580705:6tunW4VyN:m:1:3339843426:3E8B2A8A91A3A0156D051589A27A6720:r)

BLEXIT is bringing pro-America, pro-Family values to Black and minority communities through the work of our State Chapters.

Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the BLEXIT movement at the local level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

They demonstrate how people can escape the mentality of victimhood and empower others to take control of their destinies.

Just this summer, **BLEXIT-Fest in New Jersey introduced our message to over 400 people.** They had a variety of talented performers and speakers and created a memorable community celebration.

**BLEXIT chapter members from our Tampa, FL, and North Charleston, SC sites educated and cared for approximately 80 children** for six weeks during our full-day Summer Camp.

The children in our Tampa program even took a field trip to Legoland!

Now that school has started, these BLEXIT chapters are providing an after-school youth education program - Liberation Camp - for 80 children.

_BLEXIT 's Chapters are a huge part of our Back to School initiative_.

The BLEXIT Illinois Chapter **distributed over 400 school supplies** and BLEXIT merchandise in one of Chicago's most impoverished communities. The NY Chapter was fortunate to **give away 120 school supply kits as well as 40 book bags.**

BLEXIT Chapters are changing the narrative that surrounds America's minority communities.

[**We currently have 42 chapters across the US and more than 14,000 volunteers! You can help BLEXIT support our State Chapters by donating $25, $35, $50, or any other amount today. Click here to send your gift >>>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61580705:6tunW4VyN:m:1:3339843426:3E8B2A8A91A3A0156D051589A27A6720:r)

BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence reinforced by groups that market themselves as serving the Black community, such as Black Lives Matter, but in actuality, they destroy communities.

These organizations are poisoning minority communities. They tell these bright young men and women they are victims of systematic repression and that their skin color is all that defines them.

But here's the ugly truth about other organizations who claim to serve the Black community:

* They claim to support Black communities. . . but they fan the flames of riots and violence that directly impact the lives of the people in those communities.

* They claim to fight for criminal justice reform. . . but they teach Black men and women to hate and disrespect police officers.

* They claim to be a non-profit group fighting for Black men and women. . . but they use donor funds to enrich themselves.

**These other organizations are destroying Black communities, dividing our country, and forcing a message of victimhood and hatred down the throats of minorities.**

BLEXIT is countering their hateful narrative, but we can't do it alone, Peter. Can you donate to BLEXIT today and help us reach our goal of raising $50,000?

Now that school has started, these BLEXIT chapters are providing an after-school youth education program - Liberation Camp - for 80 children. BLEXIT 's Chapters are a huge part of our Back to School initiative. The BLEXIT Illinois Chapter distributed over 400 school supplies and BLEXIT merchandise in one of Chicago's most impoverished communities. The NY Chapter was fortunate to give away 120 school supply kits as well as 40 book bags. BLEXIT Chapters are changing the narrative that surrounds America's minority communities. BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence reinforced by groups that market themselves as serving the Black community, such as Black Lives Matter, but in actuality, they destroy communities. These organizations are poisoning minority communities. They tell these bright young men and women they are victims of systematic repression and that their skin color is all that defines them. But here's the ugly truth about other organizations who claim to serve the Black community: They claim to support Black communities. . . but they fan the flames of riots and violence that directly impact the lives of the people in those communities. They claim to fight for criminal justice reform. . . but they teach Black men and women to hate and disrespect police officers. They claim to be a non-profit group fighting for Black men and women. . . but they use donor funds to enrich themselves. These other organizations are destroying Black communities, dividing our country, and forcing a message of victimhood and hatred down the throats of minorities.** BLEXIT is countering their hateful narrative, but we can't do it alone, Peter. Can you donate to BLEXIT today and help us reach our goal of raising $50,000? Thank you, Candace Owens Co-Founder & President BLEXIT Foundation BLEXIT is a 501(c)3 tax-exempt organization. Friend of life,

As someone passionate to end
abortion, you need to know what's been going on the last few
weeks.

Since Roe v. Wade was overturned,
millions of dollars have been poured by donors into pro-abortion
groups. They have one goal in mind: use this mountain of cash to
fuel a landslide win for pro-abortion candidates this November.

Planned Parenthood and NARAL
Pro-Choice America saw overall contributions increase from
$630,000 to roughly $2.3 million in just three months. Every
donation represents another baby in danger of death by abortion.

Meanwhile, pro-life groups across
the country are struggling to keep up as donors have stopped
giving. Too many people have viewed the end of Roe v. Wade as the
end of the battle when it is just the beginning.

We need to activate courageous
pro-life people before midnight tonight so we can stay in the
fight and reach 34,000 moms before it's too late. Will you take a
stand with us? Give now: https://give.liveaction.org/fight-back/

Friend of Life - this is a David
vs. Goliath battle.

We are up against a
billion-dollar industry and lobby with the financial backing and
support of the elites, the media, Hollywood, and higher education
- and Planned Parenthood and its allies are increasing their
spending and political action ahead of the mid-term elections.

Why?

Because they want to ensure that
Americans reject the Court's ruling on Roe v. Wade and expand
abortion nationwide, rather than end it once and for all.

Polls show that Americans are
increasing in their support of abortion-on-demand and even
pro-life states could be on the verge of expanding abortion in
the next few months. The 24/7 media barrage funded by committed
pro-abortion donors is working and if we don't move quickly, all
of our progress over the last 40 years may disappear.

We have no time to lose and your
gift RIGHT NOW will save babies from being poisoned, torn apart,
and suctioned from their mother's wombs:
https://give.liveaction.org/fight-back/

Your unwavering conviction and
commitment to this fight is why I have hope for our future. We
will prevail in every state and overcome the horrific injustice
of abortion as we spread the truth, one heart and one life at a
time.

For life,

Lila Rose

We are up against a billion-dollar industry and lobby with the financial backing and support of the elites, the media, Hollywood, and higher education - and Planned Parenthood and its allies are increasing their spending and political action ahead of the mid-term elections. Why? Because they want to ensure that Americans reject the Court's ruling on Roe v. Wade and expand abortion nationwide, rather than end it once and for all. Friend, **Should schools be allowed to deliberately deceive parents and conduct gender transitions in secret?** Right now, woke judges are saying yes.
---
[**HELP US STOP THEM >>**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zc6i2q4k02r3rhckiqsvct6tgm4n5ofsr2o78g08_rp22sh2s8i66or5clg64oj4c5h2bs)
---
This summer, the Montgomery County Public School District released guidelines around gender identity, asserting that students have the “right” to keep their in-school gender identities private from their parents. Outraged parents sued the school district. And this month, a District Court judge ruled against the parents and threw out the lawsuit — the first ruling of its kind. Similar lawsuits in other parts of the country are still in progress, but this landmark precedent is likely to lead the way.
[**We’re standing up against this wrongly decided verdict and expressing our support for parents’ rights**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zqca2isrt61cr5rtvnlo2grmcng5280m0tnsr59o_rp22sh2s8i66or5clg64oj4c5h2bs)**[.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zg9cvsm0aopm8u8iq5o51fcq2omunoo4m5d845do_rp22sh2s8i66or5clg64oj4c5h2bs)[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zii181bk6gisl4hai1h5n0phgbqjpb4pn2vno4hg_rp22sh2s8i66or5clg64oj4c5h2bs) **School districts should NOT be allowed to conduct gender transitions on minors while intentionally hiding it from their parents and guardians.
---
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z2cp6j6r9a2gauled3tl2uki1kr7ndbhjr96v0lg_rp22sh2s8i66or5clg64oj4c5h2bs)
---
The Left wants to take over the courts to establish control over our children. They want to push their unconstitutional, un-American agenda in schools, and they want to prevent fair judges from putting an end to it. **We can’t let them.** We need judges who respect parental rights, and we will fight prosecutors who attempt to go after parents defending their children from radical ideology. **_Agree?[Sign our petition now!](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zi4ug8pg6alu2833qptg5vlct816ivlmnvc4km10_rp22sh2s8i66or5clg64oj4c5h2bs)_**

[**SIGN THE PETITION >>**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zsnb3ieoob96ptgh7606lior9uloce7tr75liitg_rp22sh2s8i66or5clg64oj4c5h2bs)
---
Friend, the woke mob is coming after our courts.

Once they have control of our courts, the far Left intends to use that power to enforce their radical agenda without ever winning a single vote. The radical Left will use the courts to:
* Strip parents of their rights to raise their children as they see fit,
* Dismantle your 2nd amendment rights,
* _And attack any of your constitutional rights that get in the way of their agenda._

We know this is their goal because they have done it before, creating a right to legal abortion on demand with _Roe_ v. _Wade._ **But**** _Roe_****v.****_Wade_****teaches us something important: We CAN fight back against judicial activism.****And when we fight back, we can WIN.** **Will you fight back with us, Friend?**

Patriot,

I don't have good news today...

**Recent polling shows my Democrat opponent, Raphael Warnock, leading by 3 points.** For months we've been in a dead heat, but now I'm slightly behind in Georgia's crucial Senate showdown.

This is a significant setback for Republicans everywhere.

I wish that was the only piece of bad news I had for you today, but it's not...

My Democrat opponent is the _leading _fundraiser in the entire country. He's raising record amounts of money in record time. The latest report shows he raised over $26 MILLION in the last 3 MONTHS. If I'm going to catch up, I need MAJOR reinforcements, which is why I'm reaching out to you today, Patriot. _**[I need you to rush an emergency contribution of ANY AMOUNT to help us close the fundraising gap.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61598770:6rvqc4VDN:m:1:3299561967:FDFF4ADC554892F08AAF649335550C4E:r "It’s important that we band
together and show the Democrats that we’re willing to do whatever it takes to pull off a win.")**_

There's too much at stake to sit on the sidelines. _Georgia is in danger. Our Senate majority is in danger. The future of our country is in danger._

Democrat Super PACs and my opponent have already spent $25 million in false attack ads against me, which is why we've lost ground in the polls. _Unfortunately, we haven't had the money to respond or set the record straight._

This is just the beginning... Democrats are already scheming on how to spend another $25 MILLION. _**[They MUST be STOPPED.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61598770:6rvqc4VDN:m:1:3299561967:FDFF4ADC554892F08AAF649335550C4E:r "It’s
important that we band together and show the Democrats that we’re willing to do whatever it takes to pull off a win.")**_

It's clear that they see me as a threat. The fate of the Senate majority will be determined by the outcome of our race in Georgia. That's why we must fully fund our ads and grassroots efforts to make sure Georgians learn the truth about Raphael Warnock's far-left record.

_**[Patriot, I need your help now more than ever. If you're able, would you please contribute $25 or more to help us close the fundraising gap? Every penny counts, and your help is CRITICAL.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61598770:6rvqc4VDN:m:1:3299561967:FDFF4ADC554892F08AAF649335550C4E:r "It’s important that we band together and show the Democrats that we’re willing to do whatever it
takes to pull off a win.")**_

Thank you for your support.

Onward to victory,

Herschel Walker
Republican for U.S. Senate

name: Trudy
subject: "Be kind and have good manners."
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trudy Busch Valentine for Senate
body:
Above everything else, I made sure that my kids were raised with compassionate hearts and respect for others.
| | |
---
Peter,

"Be kind and have good manners."
I can't count the times I repeated this mantra to my children – before family gatherings, on the first day of school, at the dinner table. **Above everything else, I made sure that my kids were raised with compassionate hearts and respect for others.**
**But frankly, it seems like far too many of the folks running things in Washington lack both.** People are pushing their far-right, out-of-touch ideologies instead of actually helping families. They're picking partisan fights instead of putting their heads down and doing the work. And if my opponent, Eric Schmitt, gets to Washington, he'll be just another extremist with no manners and no kindness.
I promise you, Peter, that I will be different. If there is one thing that sets our campaign apart from others, it's our commitment to hope, kindness, and integrity. And I am proud that every member of my team exemplifies these values each day.
Even on long days on RV trips all over Missouri, we make sure to listen to every voter with the same sincerity and focus; we make time to hear their stories; we ask them to share their concerns; and we invite them to be a part of the solutions. Whether you've cast your ballot for red or blue in the past, you have a place in our state and in our movement.
**As senator, I will treat everyone – my colleagues, my constituents, and every person who comes through my office doors – with the manners and compassion that my parents taught me, and which I passed on to my own kids.** I will always lead with kindness, respect, and a listening ear.
**But in order to get there and bring this commitment to Washington, I need your help.[Please, can I count on you to make a donation to help me flip this seat blue and bring kindness and respect to Washington? We can achieve that by flipping Florida blue – and political experts from CNN are saying _this race_ is one of Democrats' best pickup opportunities. **I'm in this to win, friend, and expand our majority – and three recent polls have shown that I'm in a position to do just that.**

clean_body: imagine what more we can do with a working Senate majority | | | Friend, I'm once again asking you for a contribution while a group of donors is still matching all gifts that come in before my fundraising deadline. Allow me to explain why this match is so important: Democrats have accomplished a great deal even with our tenuous 50-50 majority. But just imagine what more we can do with a working majority that won't let the filibuster stand in the way. We can save reproductive freedom, be bolder about confronting the climate crisis and do more to stop gun violence. We can achieve that by flipping Florida blue – and political experts from CNN are saying this race is one of Democrats' best pickup opportunities. I'm in this to win, friend, and expand our majority – and three recent polls have shown that I'm in a position to do just that. But I simply cannot accomplish all that without resources. Marco Rubio is already spending millions on vicious attack ads to defeat me, and Mitch McConnell is equipped with a war chest of more than $106 million to boost Rubio's efforts. So missing this match goal, when every donation is being doubled, will put our solid chance at flipping Florida blue at serious risk. I need you with me to show Rubio and the entire GOP what this campaign is made of. In a Nation where millions of Americans can still be fired for being gay, lesbian, bisexual, transgender, or queer, coming out still represents a substantial risk.

After years of progress, LGBTQ+ people are once again facing disgusting attacks in their communities and on the airwaves from elected officials, right-wing pundits, and even their own neighbors.

Today, on National Coming Out Day, someone you care about may show you their authentic self for the first time. In that moment, they'll be filled with a range of emotions -- from joy to fear -- and they'll be counting on you for love and acceptance. But it's not enough only to hold close the LGBTQ+ people in our own lives.

Last year, the House passed the Equality Act to prevent discrimination based on gender identity and sexual orientation. Now we need to build momentum to ensure the Senate does the same — before a new Supreme Court further erodes the freedoms of LGBTQ+ Americans.

[**It's time for Congress to end discrimination against LGBTQ+ Americans. Show you're standing with me by adding your name.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52396828/372142409/632194061?ms=em22_221011_comout_adv_gq_act___bc_ettx&refcode=em22_221011_comout_adv_gq_act___bc_ettx&source=em22_221011_comout_adv_gq_act___bc_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_221011_comout_adv_gq_act___bc_ettx&utm_medium=email&contactdata=v%2FHpeaGW52NxrawTbAD%2BRl2rRbpUbIkLyiMUhU%2FFq8Sbdh0%2BPhxS9yBZoTR1Tpw1bMvzzY0ZrpHD5CadhsrI9HagfYD8oZWx03ZnziHfqpjBliMNVAkPaXNTeyA%2B%2Bh0ayWGyW3RYQhWWl%2FquGl7lhXKn7DW0ZqkPSWNzL9Iq0vliX%2FQdWhJNANcq8dL609Gq&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDU4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmODI4ZWE4Yi04MDQ5LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4OYNVAVYLt0DSkWuByJOv871NKH2yAkoKsRIRVdPieY=&emci=4458e1e7-7949-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=f828ea8b-8049-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=8943725)

name: Josh Gottheimer
subject: The Star-Ledger: “Gottheimer gets stuff done.”
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JOSH GOTTHEIMER FOR CONGRESS
body:
# [#]Hi there!

In this Sunday’s edition of The Star-Ledger , their editorial team made their official endorsement for NJ-05 — choosing common sense over extremism.

I am honored to have received their endorsement, and hope to continue fighting for common sense policies for Jersey families.

Read their official endorsement below, and chip in $ right now to help support my campaign — with less than 30 days until Election day, your support is more important than ever. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jg-fr-2210?amount=]

Thank you,

Josh Gottheimer

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jg-fr-2210?amount= [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jg-fr-2210?amount=]This political era is defined by gridlock, and too often our federal government is brought to a screeching halt by what constitutional scholar Daniel Lazare calls “slow-motion trench warfare.”

To get the important stuff done – infrastructure, climate action, lower drug prices, law enforcement reform – some believe it takes a bulletproof majority and a miracle. In reality, however, it takes lawmakers who reject political division, embrace bipartisanship, and accept compromise.

This is how Rep. Josh Gottheimer has managed to have his fingerprints on the most significant legislation to ever come out of Washington. It is that political gift and his dedication to improving the lives of all Americans that earns the congressman from New Jersey’s 5th District our enthusiastic endorsement for a fourth term.

Gottheimer, who is being challenged for a second time by Wall Street investment banker Frank Pallotta, is an anomaly in Washington. Whereas most people in Congress stay in their lane -- pinned down by their party leaders in partisan neutral corners -- Gottheimer’s career has been defined by forming cross-party alliances as the founder of the Problem Solvers Caucus.

It is a quixotic group of 29 Democrats and 29 Republicans who meet once a week to untangle the gridlock and find common cause, and at the tip of the spear is the indefatigable former speechwriter for President Clinton. Gottheimer, 47, says he hopes one day “that we don’t need a Problem Solvers Caucus, and that people will reflexively be rewarded for bipartisan governing,” but that is unlikely when there is a 50-50 Senate and a four-seat margin in the House.

That leaves Gottheimer’s caucus as the most reliable template for democratic compromise and effective policy.

Count just a few ways:

*
He
and
the
Problem
Solvers
helped
craft
the
blueprint
for
2021
Infrastructure
Investment
and
Jobs
Act,
which
upgraded
highways,
railways,
water
systems,
the
electric
grid,
and
included
the
largest
public
transit
investment
in
history.

The
$1.25
trillion
package
didn’t
happen
without
some
prolonged
intra-party
drama
from
the
Democrats’
progressive
wing
and
Gottheimer’s
team,
but
as
colleague
Tom
Malinowski
(D-7th)
put
it,
“That
bipartisan
infrastructure
bill
would
not
exist
if
not
for
Josh.”
And
just
to
hang
a
lantern
on
it:
The
Gateway
Project
would
not
exist
without
the
bipartisan
infrastructure
bill.
*
*
In
February,
President
Biden
signed
the
CHIPS
Act,
which
included
eight
key
amendments
authored
by
Gottheimer,
including
supply
chain
fixes,
protections
against
Chinese
market
manipulation,
and
a
historic
push
for
cutting
edge
high-tech
research.
*
*
After
the
2021
Build
Back
Better
plan
withered
and
died,
Gottheimer
kept
Senate
colleagues
like
Joe
Manchin
on
speed
dial
and
helped
redraft
it
into
the
Inflation
Reduction
Act
in
August
--
the
largest
piece
of
legislation
ever
to
address
climate
change.
It
also
lowers
prescription
drug
prices,
expands
health
care,
and
goes
after
tax
cheats
–
all
while
lowering
the
deficit.
*
*
Just
two
weeks
ago,
he
celebrated
the
passage
of
his
Invest
To
Protect
Act,
which
authorizes
$60
million
a
year
for
five
years
to
provide
more
safety,
de-escalation
training,
recruitment
grants,
and
mental
health
help
for
local
police
departments.

These are echoes of what Gottheimer had accomplished in previous sessions.

With Americans still reeling from the pandemic late in 2020, Gottheimer and the caucus resuscitated the dormant stimulus bill after leadership and the Trump administration walked away from the table.

That September, the caucus found a framework for a new bill known as the “March to Common Ground,” which delivered more state and local aid, help for small businesses and the food insecure, and more unemployment assistance -- while cutting the cost of the original bill in half.

Ultimately, Trump signed it. This is what Gottheimer does: He breaks stalemates. And that has made him, after only three terms, one of the most influential members of the House.

It would be ludicrous to replace him with a political neophyte, particularly this one.

Pallotta received Trump’s support in 2020, and is anxiously awaiting a second helping.

“He likes our policies. I enjoy his policies. His policies were spot-on,” Pallotta said of Trump on WABC radio last month. “If he picked up the phone and said, ‘I’d like to endorse you,’ that’s something I would accept.”

Most voters should find that nauseating, because pledging fealty to the man who tried to subvert democracy by inciting a riot which led to the death of five cops can only give Trump more incentive to try it again.

Coaxing Trump into his corner is crucial to Pallotta’s MAGA bona fides, which is why he ignored most of the questions we sent him about the former president’s role in the attack on our government on Jan. 6 and Congress’s duty to investigate it.

For Pallotta, that seems to be old news. He says that if Trump is the nominee in 2024, he will vote for him.

If you need more evidence of Pallotta’s keen moral and political judgment, recall his vigorous defense of the Oath Keepers prior to the 2020 election, when he called them “good people,” solicited their support, and vowed to “stand by them.”

Three months later, the same domestic terrorists led the attack on the Capitol. Today, their leaders are on trial for seditious conspiracy.

On policy, Pallotta is out of central casting, as a Wall Street conservative culture warrior who rages against creeping socialism. He “can’t say” if he supports the bipartisan infrastructure bill that will be of momentous benefit to his district, and he offers no inflation solution other than tax cuts, because “that will spur growth."

That is the usual trickle-down mysticism, yet if you ask Pallotta if he would have voted for the 2017 Trump tax cuts, he responds, “It’s kind of hypothetical – I wasn’t there."

It is a predictable dodge, because that Republican tax bill did not include spending cuts to cover the cost, and the deficit exploded. That same tax cut included the unpopular $10,000 cap on state and local tax deductions (SALT), which Pallotta accuses Gottheimer of failing to repeal, even though Gottheimer has led a vociferous effort to do that.

And on social policy, Pallotta can be flat-out dangerous: He calls abortion “legalized manslaughter,” and believes it should be banned even in cases of rape and incest.

This is not a difficult choice. Gottheimer calls it “a race between common sense and extremism,” and that is hard to refute. He is a proven leader with a laudable record, he builds trust and relationships, and he has a gift for finding a sensible center and withstanding the noise from the fringes and his own party leaders. We endorse Gottheimer for a fourth term, because he occupies a political space where most Americans want their leaders to be.
Josh Gottheimer represents New Jersey’s Fifth Congressional District. Josh is in Congress to fight for lower taxes and Jersey Values. He’s working across the aisle to find real solutions for New Jersey families and is actively fighting against the ideological gridlock in Washington. Gottheimer, 47, says he hopes one day “that we don’t need a Problem Solvers Caucus, and that people will reflexively be rewarded for bipartisan governing,” but that is unlikely when there is a 50-50 Senate and a four-seat margin in the House. That leaves Gottheimer’s caucus as the most reliable template for democratic compromise and effective policy. Count just a few ways: He and the Problem Solvers helped craft the blueprint for 2021 Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act, which upgraded highways, railways, water systems, the electric grid, and included the largest public transit investment in history. The $1.25 trillion package didn’t happen without some prolonged intra-party drama from the Democrats’ progressive wing and Gottheimer’s team, but as colleague Tom Malinowski (D-7th) put it, “That bipartisan infrastructure bill would not exist if not for Josh.” And just to hang a lantern on it: The Gateway Project would not exist without the bipartisan infrastructure bill. In February, President Biden signed the CHIPS Act, which included eight key amendments authored by Gottheimer, including supply chain fixes, protections against Chinese market manipulation, and a historic push for cutting edge high-tech research. After the 2021 Build Back Better plan withered and died, Gottheimer kept Senate colleagues like Joe Manchin on speed dial and helped redraft it into the Inflation Reduction Act in August -- the largest piece of legislation ever to address climate change. It also lowers prescription drug prices, expands health care, and goes after tax cheats – all while lowering the deficit. * Just two weeks ago, he celebrated the passage of his Invest To Protect Act, which authorizes $60 million a year for five years to provide more safety, de-escalation training, recruitment grants, and mental health help for local police departments. These are echoes of what Gottheimer had accomplished in previous sessions. With Americans still reeling from the pandemic late in 2020, Gottheimer and the caucus resuscitated the dormant stimulus bill after leadership and the Trump administration walked away from the table. That September, the caucus found a framework for a new bill known as the “March to Common Ground,” which delivered more state and local aid, help for small businesses and the food insecure, and more unemployment assistance -- while cutting the cost of the original bill in half. Ultimately, Trump signed it. This is what Gottheimer does: He breaks stalemates. And that has made him, after only three terms, one of the most influential members of the House. It would be ludicrous to replace him with a political neophyte, particularly this one. Pallotta received Trump’s support in 2020, and is anxiously awaiting a second helping. “He likes our policies. I enjoy his policies. His policies were spot-on,” Pallotta said of Trump on WABC radio last month. “If he picked up the phone and said, ‘I’d like to endorse you,’ that’s something I would accept.” Most voters should find that nauseating, because pledging fealty to the man who tried to subvert democracy by inciting a riot which led to the death of five cops can only give Trump more incentive to try it again. Coaxing Trump into his corner is crucial to Pallotta’s MAGA bona fides, which is why he ignored most of the questions we sent him about the former president’s role in the attack on our government on Jan. 6 and Congress’s duty to investigate it. For Pallotta, that seems to be old news. He says that if Trump is the nominee in 2024, he will vote for him. If you need more evidence of Pallotta’s keen moral and political judgment, recall his vigorous defense of the Oath Keepers prior to the 2020 election, when he called them “good people,” solicited their support, and vowed to “stand by them.” Three months later, the same domestic terrorists led the attack on the Capitol. Today, their leaders are on trial for seditious conspiracy. On policy, Pallotta is out of central casting, as a Wall Street conservative culture warrior who rages against creeping socialism. He “can’t say” if he supports the bipartisan infrastructure bill that will be of momentous benefit to his district, and he offers no inflation solution other than tax cuts, because “that will spur growth." That is the usual trickle-down mysticism, yet if you ask Pallotta if he would have voted for the 2017 Trump tax cuts, he responds, “It’s kind of hypothetical – I wasn’t there." It is a predictable dodge, because that Republican tax bill did not include spending cuts to cover the cost, and the deficit exploded. That same tax cut included the unpopular $10,000 cap on state and local tax deductions (SALT), which Pallotta accuses Gottheimer of failing to repeal, even though Gottheimer has led a vociferous effort to do that. And on social policy, Pallotta can be flat-out dangerous: He calls abortion “legalized manslaughter,” and believes it should be banned even in cases of rape and incest. This is not a difficult choice. Gottheimer calls it “a race between common sense and extremism,” and that is hard to refute. He is a proven leader with a laudable record, he builds trust and relationships, and he has a gift for finding a sensible center and withstanding the noise from the fringes and his own party leaders. We endorse Gottheimer for a fourth term, because he occupies a political space where most Americans want their leaders to be. Josh Gottheimer represents New Jersey’s Fifth Congressional District. Josh is in Congress to fight for lower taxes and Jersey Values. He’s working across the aisle to find real solutions for New Jersey families and is actively fighting against the ideological gridlock in Washington. #
Derek,
In just a moment, I’m going to ask you to **make a contribution of any amount to support John Fetterman’s campaign for U.S. Senate in Pennsylvania.** But first, I hope you will give me a chance to explain why your support is so important.
Right now, two votes in the Senate are blocking the agenda of the American people. From expanding voting rights, to strengthening our nation’s unions, to addressing the climate crisis, we have been blocked again and again from passing meaningful legislation that would address the long-neglected needs of working people in this country.
In a time where the ultra-rich are only growing richer, working people are falling further behind and are losing even more support from their elected representatives. It’s a status quo we can’t allow to continue.
**That’s why I’m writing to you about Pennsylvania’s U.S. Senate race.** Not only do we have a real chance to elect a leader like John Fetterman who will take on powerful special interests — this race is one of our best opportunities to flip a seat, expand our Senate majority, and finally show the American people a government that works for them instead of the wealthiest few.
In order to elect John and flip this seat, we need to come together and show as much support as possible in these critical final weeks. So I am asking you:
**[Will you donate $5 right now to John Fetterman’s campaign for U.S. Senate? This is one of the most important races happening in our country, and he needs our support to win.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221011-1?refcode=em20221011-7660&refcode2=7660_434096_nOXN44&akid=7660%2E434096%2EnOXN44)**

John Fetterman is a different kind of Democrat.
He supported legalizing marijuana before it was popular, officiated a same-sex marriage before it was legal, and pushed for universal healthcare long before it was mainstream.
If elected to the Senate, we don’t have to wonder where John will stand. He will take on corporate greed, make the wealthy pay their fair share in taxes, and fight for the working class of this country — not the rich and powerful.
But right now, within our corrupt campaign finance system, John is up against tens of millions of dollars from right-wing super PACs that are running grossly dishonest attack ads trying to defeat him. We cannot allow these billionaire-funded super PACs to succeed, which is why I’m asking again:

Anything you’re able to contribute today will help ensure we have a crucial vote in the Senate to pass legislation that could transform this country. Thank you for chipping in today, if you can afford it.
In solidarity,
Bernie Sanders

** Early Voting—What are We Trying to Solve?
------------------------------------------------------------

This Election Day, you will see a question about early voting on the ballot. This same proposed amendment was voted down in 2014 and reappears now as an open-ended proposal that, if affirmed, would give unlimited powers to lawmakers to extend early voting in any manner and for any duration as decided by a simple majority of lawmakers.

Early voting is not right for Connecticut and is a solution looking for a problem. Here’s why:
* Chaos with Election Officials: Early Voting states have full-time election officials while Connecticut has mostly part-time Registrars.Thirty days of early voting, for example, would introduce chaos to this group of professionals. This would affect their full-time employment and leave municipalities scrambling for personnel replacements and/or funds to pay for overtime.
* Connecticut has Decentralized Voting: In states with early voting, elections are organized around county-based elections whereas several towns are aggregated around early voting precincts with full resources. Connecticut would have to establish at least one voting precinct in 169 towns for an unspecified period of operation.
* Unfunded Mandate: Establishing voting centers in 169 towns, with part-time registrars, for up to 30 days could cost as much as $15M to $20M in personnel and site rentals. Most schools would not be available as election centers.
* Reduced Voter Engagement: Connecticut primaries end in mid-August and early voting begins as early as week 2 of October. This leaves 6-8 weeks for voter engagement and education before the first votes are cast.
* Smaller Campaigns Disenfranchised: The extension of Get Out The Vote (GOTV) efforts could make it cost-prohibitive for small campaigns to compete over a prolonged period.

The Bottom Line: Early voting reduces a voter’s opportunity to learn more about the issues, and the candidates. Additionally, voters may miss the revelations of an “October surprise.”And Connecticut already has one of the highest voter turnouts in the country. So what problem are we trying to solve?

** Don’t Miss Dominic’s Debate Next Week!
------------------------------------------------------------

Next Tuesday, October, Sept. 18, the rescheduled debate against my opponent, Democrat Stephanie Thomas—which will air across allCT Public platforms (https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=7e10dd14ce&e=8763c56857) , including PBS and NPR, beginning at 8 p.m. The debate will take place at the Lincoln Theater on the campus of the University of Hartford and is sponsored by the League of Women Voters.

I look forward to representing our principles and values on this very important stage.

I hope you will tune in!

Thank you and Godspeed,

Dominic Rapini

Republican Candidate for Secretary of the State

subject: Put an end to Ken Calvert’s corruption.
body:
|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52400022/372152568/-707005773?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzcxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZjNhZDZlNy04NjQ5LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UanmDQv1fJyFgbBGAi9I6jzMVELauQez7Zd-hQGzaJA=)
Peter,

For the first time in decades, Ken Calvert is being forced to run an actual campaign in a competitive seat, so years of corrupt practices are coming to light.

Here’s one example: In 2005, Ken Calvert purchased property near the March Air Reserve Base near Perris, CA. Months later, he sold that land for nearly a half-million dollar profit. Turns out, he directed earmarks to build a highway exchange nearby that property right before the sale — boosting its value.

**In fact, Ken Calvert has increased his net worth by up to $20,000,000 since assuming office. He was also ranked one of the “most corrupt members of Congress” by nonpartisan ethics watchdogs.**

A big reason people lost trust in our government officials is because of political corruption like this. That's why one of the first bills I look forward to passing is a **total ban on stock trading** by Members of Congress.
