disclaimer_text: Paid for by Oregon League of Conservation Voters and authorized by Andrea Salinas for Congress
body:
| | | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52401038/372156021/1535989350?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjE4YjAyZWQ2LTg4NDktZWQxMS1iNDk1LTAwMjI0ODI1OGQzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=6JgJCxUSPfqfDGbPnYn5FvidbFMnr3-GEcCyMLu4ixQ=&emci=904d1fb4-ee48-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=18b02ed6-8849-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=2107230) |
---|---
| | Dear Peter, This December, our state has a massive opportunity to reduce pollution. Soon, Oregon’s Environmental Quality Commission (EQC) will vote on whether or not Oregon should adopt the Advanced Clean Cars II (ACCII) rule. This might sound familiar to you because several months ago we urged you to take action and push California to adopt this rule. Well, California adopted the rule, putting the state on track to eliminate the sale of new gas cars and sell only new zero-emission vehicles by 2035. **[Now, we need your help to ensure Oregon does the same!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52401040/372156023/1535989350?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjE4YjAyZWQ2LTg4NDktZWQxMS1iNDk1LTAwMjI0ODI1OGQzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=6JgJCxUSPfqfDGbPnYn5FvidbFMnr3-GEcCyMLu4ixQ=&emci=904d1fb4-ee48-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=18b02ed6-8849-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=2107230)** Oregon’s EQC just opened a public comment period giving you and other members of the public a chance to tell them you support adopting the clean cars rule. But, the comment period closes on Oct. 21st, so we only have a limited time to speak up! **[Can we count on you to send a message asking them to adopt the clean cars rule?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52401043/372156026/1535989350?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjE4YjAyZWQ2LTg4NDktZWQxMS1iNDk1LTAwMjI0ODI1OGQzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=6JgJCxUSPfqfDGbPnYn5FvidbFMnr3-GEcCyMLu4ixQ=&emci=904d1fb4-ee48-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=18b02ed6-8849-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=2107230)** Transportation is the largest source of pollution in Oregon, making up 40% of the state’s total emissions–– with the majority of that pollution generated by personal cars and trucks. Vehicle exhaust spews carbon and toxic chemical pollutants into our air, which are linked to higher rates of cancer, heart disease, and other serious health conditions. In fact, the American Lung Association gave our state failing scores for air quality in nearly every county they recorded data. **_We can’t accept unhealthy, polluted air as the standard in Oregon_** – **[we need your help to urge the EQC to adopt the clean cars rule and guarantee cleaner air for our state.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52401047/372156030/1535989350?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjE4YjAyZWQ2LTg4NDktZWQxMS1iNDk1LTAwMjI0ODI1OGQzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=6JgJCxUSPfqfDGbPnYn5FvidbFMnr3-GEcCyMLu4ixQ=&emci=904d1fb4-ee48-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=18b02ed6-8849-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=2107230)** As we stand, low-income and BIPOC (Black, Indigenous, people of color) communities – the same communities that often live in areas with higher pollution levels – have the hardest time accessing clean cars. Thankfully, there are provisions to improve access to zero-emission vehicles through reduced, affordable pricing for emission-free vehicles and community mobility programs built into the clean cars rule, which will make sure there is equity in zero-emission transportation for Oregon. The clean cars rule will strengthen Oregon’s tailpipe emissions standards and gradually reduce pollution by increasingly phasing electric, zero-emission vehicles onto our roads. This means that 100% of new cars and trucks sold in Oregon will be emission-free by 2035– a shift that would remove 54.1 million metric tons of vehicle pollution from the air we breathe. In other words, **this rule is the single best tool and chance Oregon has to dramatically slash transportation pollution levels in our state.** **[We need you to take action and urge Oregon’s EQC to follow California’s lead in adopting the clean cars rule for our state.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52401051/372156034/1535989350?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjE4YjAyZWQ2LTg4NDktZWQxMS1iNDk1LTAwMjI0ODI1OGQzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=6JgJCxUSPfqfDGbPnYn5FvidbFMnr3-GEcCyMLu4ixQ=&emci=904d1fb4-ee48-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=18b02ed6-8849-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=2107230)** Thank you,

Julia DeGraw
Coalition Director, OLCV |

clean_body: | | | | ---|--- | | Dear Peter, This December, our state has a massive opportunity to reduce pollution. Soon, Oregon’s Environmental Quality Commission (EQC) will vote on whether or not Oregon should adopt the Advanced Clean Cars II (ACCII) rule. This might sound familiar to you because several months ago we urged you to take action and push California to adopt this rule. Well, California adopted the rule, putting the state on track to eliminate the sale of new gas cars and sell only new zero-emission vehicles by 2035. Oregon’s EQC just opened a public comment period giving you and other members of the public a chance to tell them you support adopting the clean cars rule. But, the comment period closes on Oct. 21st, so we only have a limited time to speak up! Transportation is the largest source of pollution in Oregon, making up 40% of the state’s total emissions–– with the majority of that pollution generated by personal cars and trucks. Vehicle exhaust spews carbon and toxic chemical pollutants into our air, which are linked to higher rates of cancer, heart disease, and other serious health conditions. In fact, the American Lung Association gave our state failing scores for air quality in nearly every county they recorded data. We can’t accept unhealthy, polluted air as the standard in Oregon – As we stand, low-income and BIPOC (Black, Indigenous, people of color) communities – the same communities that often live in areas with higher pollution levels – have the hardest time accessing clean cars. Thankfully, there are provisions to improve access to zero-emission vehicles through reduced, affordable pricing for emission-free vehicles and community mobility programs built into the clean cars rule, which will make sure there is equity in zero-emission transportation for Oregon. The clean cars rule will strengthen Oregon’s tailpipe emissions standards and gradually reduce pollution by increasingly phasing electric, zero-emission vehicles onto our roads. This means that 100% of new cars and trucks sold in Oregon will be emission-free by 2035– a shift that would remove 54.1 million metric tons of vehicle pollution from the air we breathe. In other words, this rule is the single best tool and chance Oregon has to dramatically slash transportation pollution levels in our state. Thank you, Julia DeGraw Coalition Director, OLCV | ---|--- | | Connect With Us: | | Contact Info: Oregon League of Conservation Voters 321 SW 4th Ave Ste 600 Portland, OR 97204 United States | ---|--- | If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please. body:

With 28 days left until Election Day, that is simply not going to get the race won. If we don't step up our pace of fundraising soon, we're going to lose. | [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=69a92363731c4629a34784f2f4f02fac&_e=cejKEQkTpmdzPQzSTtx8h17Hl95QFKtpIaXTKsttvFsAb9tbI9wK5Q_zG-kJQaR-n6N9ZVvRGNJ4wvPQ3v9yELQyXmenjxQqETHWquaTHs5lfpt5jWam6D8IVzRWiVztphnMF4QsxH78_sDz2LQSxkOl0NAyb5570tL4j_GgwV2AxoHBoiARfRL9trUUxI17eun6WbCzZBgVPnz36WFbGyzhjTwIXWCex6hOQRrGUwA7z-3N833nlAmAVSTt7iIzsSGXNd6f3mvjQig8fVlLkWFOslNRxZDeP4Pmq3GZJMc7bAHiDxZ57jgLhLBUke3x_619t2yJBCtuZokKizOVT2xkGVD35uSjvST5yE64tOQc_gxKIZNU_feSXGcUZKWpphOp5pX0foJhEPjsXUNlnw%3D%3D)

Peter,

Last week, my campaign sent you an email to let you know that my race is tightening up as we barrel toward Election Day. It was my hope that the news about _**Politico**_ moving my race from “**likely Democrat** ” to “**lean Democrat** ” would get all of you excited.

**The response was lukewarm, to say the least.** Just 10 supporters donated to my campaign all day last Thursday.

**With just 28 days until Election Day,** that is how we lose this race – and the House majority. Peter, my opponent and her allies are spending more than $500,000 to attack me and slander my good name to the voters I’m asking to support me. With our race **TIED** this close to ballots going in the mail, we cannot afford to lose your support now.

Today, we need to double what we raised off last week’s email. That means before midnight tonight we need to see $2,418 in donations come through. **Are you able to chip in a couple of dollars to help me out right now?**

| [**HELP US AVOID BUDGET CUTS** **› › **](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=69a92363731c4629a34784f2f4f02fac&_e=cejKEQkTpmdzPQzSTtx8h17Hl95QFKtpIaXTKsttvFsAb9tbI9wK5Q_zG-kJQaR-n6N9ZVvRGNJ4wvPQ3v9yELQyXmenjxQqETHWquaTHs5lfpt5jWam6D8IVzRWiVztphnMF4QsxH78_sDz2LQSxkOl0NAyb5570tL4j_GgwV2AxoHBoiARfRL9trUUxI17eun6WbCzZBgVPnz36WFbGyzhjTwIXWCex6hOQRrGUwA7z-3N833nlAmAVSTt7iIzNeZMdToqb-7AiQS9Zkq28Oqkx-DN5xcTLDQndwu5e5Jzk3Ysy-Q8BxYsiZTZNaAxjI2aYdjcCazpRAg09rXN5v5r1E1qAzPkSELhm4hagRIJ6Ztdbhvw4OmMUF3EvDax--xI6Vs7uZYtlDD8l-xByw%3D%3D)
---

We just assumed that fundraising would pick up this month, and they have not. **Unless we turn things around quickly, we’re going to be facing budget cuts in the final days of this race** - which no one wants.

Respectfully,

subject: I’m asking for the most important endorsement yet — yours.

body:
Your support is what keeps me going.

Team,

I have one quick ask before tonight’s debate.

Since kicking off my campaign last fall, I have been honored to accept the endorsements of Democratic leaders at every level of government: civil rights organizations, labor unions, and everyday people who believe in my vision for the future of Los Angeles.

Still, there’s another crucial endorsement I’m seeking. **Yours.**

[**Will you endorse my campaign? Add your name to the growing list of supporters before I take the stage in tonight’s debate.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52408367/372166974/1650049464?ms=em22_221011_predbt_engg_gq_act_end_KB_ettx&refcode=em22_221011_predbt_engg_gq_act_end_KB_ettx&source=em22_221011_predbt_engg_gq_act_end_KB_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_221011_predbt_engg_gq_act_end_KB_ettx&utm_medium=email&contactdata=nsEN73HsU46ADdSvzsC9R8664flaiVgkhra1zPVu8Dgki4v8Bjx%2BjFzW9Xxm1MnXHd3%2FYpjUjwtfNbtSAcKrOQa1we4qeKEuqA%2FfMRUAZorXDGS6fH5V6vcz4ampOnYp1rlDekfOSD7awmUIl15nPA%3D%3D&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85NDYxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkN2E3MmM4My04ZTQ5LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=r9yM3smAqHCFNgnMV2XTY6p1MhdQy40QsjTZl8U7isU=&emci=22655b8c-7249-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=d7a72c83-8e49-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=2429742)

This campaign is about so much more than simply winning the race. It’s about bringing people together across race, religion, age, and gender. Once that final vote is tallied on November 8, _the real work begins_ , and I want you onboard.

2. I’ve worked with the firefighters and meatpackers union to make sure they have the workplace protections, benefits, pay, training, and equipment they deserve.

3. Two of my biggest inspirations are my grandpa – a union painter – and my grandma – a public school teacher. From my grandpa, I learned how unions built and sustained the middle class, and from my grandma, I learned the value of a good education.

name: Kristina Karamo
subject: News From the Trail, CMU Parade and this Week's Stops
body:
I had a blast at the Central Michigan University Homecoming Parade on Saturday. It was so great to see the energy of the students. They understand what's at stake: their future. It's great to see the youth of our country waking up and pushing back on the indoctrination that is being forced upon them. Go Chippewas!

Sunday found me in Jackson for a BBQ event at the Reagan Ranch. It was great to be on the program with Tudor Dixon and Matt DePerno. It was a sold-out event, the people were fired-up, and the BBQ was delicious!
On Tuesday I'll be up in Antrim County at Bill Bailey's farm for a fundraiser. On the way home on Wednesday I will make several stops. From noon to 2pm, I'll be at Black River Party Store, 9720 M68-33 in Onaway. Let's meet up and enjoy some complimentary pizza!

Then I'm on to Gaylord for a stop at Mama Leone's from 5pm to 7pm, 2583 South Old 27. Please stop in!

This coming weekend we are holding overpass rallies across the state. Click on this link to see if there is a rally scheduled by you [https://kristinakaramo.com/road-rallies](https://rightstrategies.us/email/l/0Qky4uvr892tttSpAxJb8920tw/7GBttr7763m6763o9ItB3VOCoQ/TvYviTgRbCg7BfxprMfLSg). | Friend,

It all comes down to me.

The Senate. America. Our children's future. Everything is riding on my race against John Fetterman.

I'm not afraid of this fight. I would never have jumped in this race if I wasn't ready for such a huge responsibility.

But I can't afford to be shy with so much on the line. So I'll just come right out and ask: **_[Can I count on you to dig deep and chip in whatever you can to help me win?](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zs83gqgdprfjirtg51fu5ulmmcg1nlh1cpekag78_rp22sh2s8i66or5cli68or4cth2bs "Can I count on you to dig deep and chip in whatever you can to help me win?")_**

John Fetterman simply cannot be allowed in Congress. His priorities will crush American families and put our communities at risk.

**He has pushed to free convicted murderers amid a massive spike in violent crime, and he 's committed to growing America's bloated and expensive bureaucracy.**

Fetterman's agenda will devastate our country, Friend. But he's still polling just ahead of me, thanks to his MASSIVE cash advantage.

We're now less than **30 days** from Election Day and this race is shaping up to be one of the most expensive in history. **My opponent raised over $5.5 MILLION in August from fundraising emails just like this.**

_**[That's why I'm coming to you and asking for a donation of any amount to supercharge my campaign and wash away Fetterman's cash advantage.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zcquog40c959hk9qkq0edh263eldcn4gnf3jicpo_rp22sh2s8i66or5cli68or4cth2bs "That’s why I’m coming to you and asking for a donation of any amount to supercharge my campaign and wash away Fetterman’s cash advantage.")**_

I'm ready to face down my opponent's massive political machine by myself, Friend. But it would really help if I had you on my side.

Thank you for your generous support,
Dr. Oz

**The deadline to register to vote for the November 2022 election is today, October 11.** This is your last day to ensure your voice is heard in this election. After tonight’s deadline, early voting will begin on October 24, and the election will be fully underway. We need to ensure that every voter who wants to cast a ballot registers before tonight’s deadline, including you, team.

**_[We need to guarantee as many votes as possible to ensure the will of the people is followed this November. Can you take a moment to take our pledge and let us know your plan to vote today?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnkUOBOsRMZneEr17QAONr0nVBz4sTeVmC6DULYBMB4YQk-8E3Q_0lBDpOC7ofR9JFehtN3Di5plwsdiiofaJb6UGttz5HkcAWmo3euUYvcydegbbJqkTxz3yPw2lK6TNg-HFN01xgBAchl6bmZ-9fLJBNjsMw65d8OIf9JSK7wmsqRwSBrYwTC3b1ZPIWzNpfX1IYpeNwgF6t6GjL3Ibk2N0R7vUAJfM4J_KXRRVAtfycc-VJxdXUIMl7KJ04Tx-me366U3pb7-deRMiNfa8_gVVpq2D2MrDzZf2P7Mpofd4eZ_1t-KMn2ic3RDUY1nSAYFoiHn8_SAUy5rF4aef3yk_omqiDuh7r0mac-2vf5b-Q/3q7/kfyl2jPZRtmhHmp3hbGEtg/h1/4YspWEUNXUVV4hh0rMij8H0uQBCDzRYq9ROFljn3WB8)_** **[MAKE YOUR PLEDGE](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnkUOBOsRMZneEr17QAONr0nVBz4sTeVmC6DULYBMB4YQk-8E3Q_0lBDpOC7ofR9JFehtN3Di5plwsdiiofaJb6UwF8Kn17pddzJVhlKba0p1YwXxr0prNO7hEReeEQfsOS9__e20PmOSVblbYHYZDgEtH3aR-CT7JqYYYEls1fRTaQlHxn8Llg8PFo1ZiceehMaJp-n1THEDKawcV-fH4nSfDIaFWVJs7TKdjXZ8ET-DfKP3XVJPxw8uWJZLcfq1EzzQuZJHT2P--Nvu1pi6ftEgCI82C6HO42oJaplurFTTFqrkhU28bLrIkuis7mTMvjX2YKnfSQ1LacE2wKY22f5PwtG6RbLIQvTNgKuPem61w/3q7/kfyl2jPZRtmhHmp3hbGEtg/h2/-SoBBKPOZfW_cWWv4rLXUKNkltCYUqD_F3Dxf0vrhBw)** Our right to vote is not guaranteed, team. Fellow American,

Last week, my campaign sent you an email to let you know that my race is tightening up as we barrel toward Election Day. It was my hope that the news about _**Politico**_ moving my race from “**likely Democrat** ” to “**lean Democrat** ” would get all of you excited.

**The response was lukewarm, to say the least.** Just 10 supporters donated to my campaign all day last Thursday.

**With just 28 days until Election Day,** that is how we lose this race – and the House majority. Fellow American, my opponent and her allies are spending more than $500,000 to attack me and slander my good name to the voters I’m asking to support me. **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

body:

| | Dear Friend, There's this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true.

It's a narrative that you'll often see pushed by a dysfunctional media or toxic culture. And as long as the idea is considered "correct" by the "right" people like TV talking heads, celebrities, or the masses on social media, the general public believes it.

That's why the Libertas Institute published this eBook in our Tuttle Twins series: **[_The Tuttle Rebuttals: 40 Responses to Popular Political and Economic Myths._](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zhehsi8djifkrrcs2fqjp53a5r5ane20n674rmb0_rp22sh2s8i66or5cli62o72c9h2bs)**

---
| | And today, we want to send a copy to your inbox for FREE.

Inside this important eBook, you'll get a clear analysis of some of the biggest political and economic myths infecting our world today like:
* Overpopulation is destroying the world
* Global climate change can be reversed by law
* Capitalism creates winners and losers
* Socialism helps the poor

**[https://act.libertasutah.org/tt-the-tuttle-rebuttals](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zdc6u0uvnjkcu62e7smofq0k2l1uec40t4qv9hko_rp22sh2s8i66or5cli62o72c9h2bs)**

Connor Boyack

Fellow American,

**The Radical Left never seems to learn their lesson.**

Last year, Democrats took their attacks to Twitter, calling me _“Uncle Tim”_ in reference to an anti-slavery novel written in 1852 that is often used to demean Black people.

I wasn’t mad or infuriated; I was more disappointed than anything. It’s one thing to negatively attack my policies, **but to attack me based on my skin color is just wrong.**

The same thing has happened to my friend, [**George Logan**](http://links.georgeloganforcongress.com/u/click?_t=ab154d37b4f04f71ab6ab4c65effe590&_m=4ce5811fde4e4c61ba4b839c2f43cb3d&_e=YA9A5aNe--3UqhAsB1OUukFEfjX9R5l9lUL65gMLmIm6Nwr0BkzAZwqdpJIVs2DLKWydy2yKNNRH28fL8xac9nB8NOfctHVaL0oRd9Saip5IpnztDDHM4YkvrM7XFYZDjP54tUZUefoOpiR38nup9rjBiO7oGJxwkpj_9I_r9lmQINCe1WiHHiEbAJwG_dh8tYxaYZQDsNMlaWh9_MOAGmddZs8Cl-6jL9_v9BxVptcoo7OCW8lY0nd8bOakNZ9AyWHmbtR1fdgCN4-4euTd5dt4RV6oWj2iLeOUk5tkoAqpWuwOS6s8WcrijncyxYFhUJlnHTnSDGLCE3deAczvKJhGDpv62ybVa-_JKktqoUgFadoVaBCmGKwt80fhAavc5bgSXY6kDvY4jy5do0_3nQ%3D%3D), who is running for Congress in CT-05. **A few months ago, Connecticut Democrats posted a tweet that compared George to a monkey, one of the lowest, old political playbook attacks that I have seen.**

But it didn’t stop George. He stayed the course and continued reaching out to constituents about plans for our nation’s future and ensuring that if elected to Congress, **he will serve them.**

| [**HELP GEORGE TAKE BACK THE HOUSE › ›**](http://links.georgeloganforcongress.com/u/click?_t=ab154d37b4f04f71ab6ab4c65effe590&_m=4ce5811fde4e4c61ba4b839c2f43cb3d&_e=YA9A5aNe--3UqhAsB1OUukFEfjX9R5l9lUL65gMLmIm6Nwr0BkzAZwqdpJIVs2DLKWydy2yKNNRH28fL8xac9nB8NOfctHVaL0oRd9Saip5IpnztDDHM4YkvrM7XFYZDjP54tUZUefoOpiR38nup9rjBiO7oGJxwkpj_9I_r9lmQINCe1WiHHiEbAJwG_dh8tYxaYZQDsNMlaWh9_MOAGmddZs8Cl-6jL9_v9BxVptcoo7OCW8lY0nd8bOakNZ9AVzV9tKiQmTFPa3GDf59x-zNCVuposdXCb0zG_yVL-6aK5iuhZEm1pAbG_bPZr0ZA51GuVq9SQ4ao3u2n6RSjZzkkWcNS7m4y5bEMMQccwfVOfQoOnNwRX4w7Rwj6kZF4seTh-UC7KKsbdsrxFLnZbg%3D%3D)

**Hageman endorsed by National Federation of Independent Business**
---
Harriet Hageman, Republican nominee for the U.S. House of Representatives in Wyoming, was today endorsed by the National Federation of Independent Business (NFIB), the leading small business association which advocates for lower taxes and fewer regulations. The endorsement came officially from NFIB’s FedPAC.
“We are pleased to endorse Harriet Hageman for election today,” said Tony Gagliardi, NFIB Wyoming State Director. “She recognizes how excessive government regulations limit small businesses and has experience working on regulatory issues. She has committed to tackling economic issues facing small business owners, including rising inflation costs and workforce shortages. Harriet Hageman will be a small business champion in Congress, and we look forward to working with her.”
“Harriet Hageman understands the concerns of small business owners in Wyoming,” said Sharon Sussin, NFIB Senior National Political Director. “We know she will be a supporter of small business owners in Congress and will prioritize strengthening the small business economy.”
Hageman issued the following statement:
“Small businesses are the entrepreneurs, the employers who fuel our communities and create jobs in Wyoming. I am grateful and honored to have the support of the NFIB, because we share the same drive to keep government off the backs of the people who make our economy go and employ millions of Americans. The Biden administration is openly hostile to free enterprise and when I get to Congress, I will be a voice for these hard-working men and women fighting to make a living.”

clean_body: | | | | Hageman endorsed by National Federation of Independent Business Harriet Hageman, Republican nominee for the U.S. House of Representatives in Wyoming, was today endorsed by the National Federation of Independent Business (NFIB), the leading small business association which advocates for lower taxes and fewer regulations. The endorsement came officially from NFIB’s FedPAC. “We are pleased to endorse Harriet Hageman for election today,” said Tony Gagliardi, NFIB Wyoming State Director. “She recognizes how excessive government regulations limit small businesses and has experience working on regulatory issues. She has committed to tackling economic issues facing small business owners, including rising inflation costs and workforce shortages. Harriet Hageman will be a small business champion in Congress, and we look forward to working with her.” “Harriet Hageman understands the concerns of small business owners in Wyoming,” said Sharon Sussin, NFIB Senior National Political Director. “We know she will be a supporter of small business owners in Congress and will prioritize strengthening the small business economy.” Hageman issued the following statement: “Small businesses are the entrepreneurs, the employers who fuel our communities and create jobs in Wyoming. I am grateful and honored to have the support of the NFIB, because we share the same drive to keep government off the backs of the people who make our economy go and employ millions of Americans. The Biden administration is openly hostile to free enterprise and when I get to Congress, I will be a voice for these hard-working men and women fighting to make a living.” | | | |

Team,
Election Day is 28 days away.
About 10 months ago, I was learning for the first time what the new district lines would look like. Since then, I’ve been getting to know the new 7th district. I’ve talked with voters, visited small businesses, attended some of mid-Michigan’s best community festivals (can’t wait for Gizzardfest 2023!) and learned about the hyper-local issues that impact these communities.
And now we’ve nearly made it. In 28 short days, Michiganders will head to the polls to cast their vote.
So let me break down what’s left to do. In true Team Slotkin fashion, as we dial in on Election Day we’re only scaling up our efforts. In the next 28 days, we’ll be continuing to air advertisements on TV and digital platforms, knocking on doors, registering voters, encouraging folks to vote early, distributing yard signs, and hosting more campaign events than seems logistically possible (trust me, you don’t want to see my calendar).
We’re officially at the point where every dollar counts. $5 buys a yard sign, $22 pays one of our student organizers for an hour, $150 covers an entire canvassing shift at Michigan State University.
The only way I’m able to do any of this is with the support of generous folks such as yourself. So, if you’re willing, consider making a contribution to help us make the next month count. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221011&amount=28]

Mike Lee

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

Team –

I gave it all I had on the debate stage last Thursday night. Now, voting begins in Arizona TOMORROW. That means our window to reach the voters we need is closing.

I’m gonna keep working hard all the way to Election Day, but I’ll be honest: A lot of this depends on you.

This was always going to be one of the most expensive races in the country. But the amount of outside money coming into Arizona to boost Blake Masters and hurt my campaign is shocking – even for me. It feels like another super PAC or dark-money group is announcing another million-dollar TV ad every couple days.

And after Masters had his biggest platform yet at our debate last week, we’ve got to be able to set the record straight.

Especially after the NRSC reversed course and has decided to spend an additional SEVEN figures in Arizona between now and the election. It’s a sign that they are all-in on Masters and will do anything to close the gap in these final weeks.

I know I’ve asked a lot, team. But I really need your help, and the ball’s in your court now. This seat is at risk, and if we don’t hold onto it we’re likely to lose the Senate.

So, how about it:

GET YOUR TICKETS: Lucinda Williams and Devon Gilfillian will be playing a benefit concert for Heidi Campbell in her run for Tennessee's 5th Congressional District 🔥

Grammy nominated Nashville Soulful roots rocker Devon Gilfillian will perform an opening set for three time Grammy award winning artist Lucinda Williams at the legendary Belcourt Theatre in Nashville on Monday October 17th for a get out the vote fundraiser with Tennessee’s 5th Congressional District Democratic candidate, Senator Heidi Campbell.

Gilfillian will perform an opening set for Lucinda Williams whose catalogue of world-wide hits includes “Car Wheels on a Gravel Road,” “Can’t Let Go,” “Word Without Tears,” “Fruits of My Labor,” and “Passionate Kisses." In September, BMI awarded Williams with its top songwriter award, the Troubadour Award. The honoree was celebrated with videos by Steve Earle , Ray Kennedy, and Elizabeth Cook . Some of Americana's biggest stars saluted her in song. Lucinda’s critically acclaimed album ‘Good Souls Better Angels’ is out now.

Heidi Campbell; a Mom, a former Musician, a former Mayor, and a Senator, is running for the District 5th Congressional seat which includes Davidson County, plus a gerrymandered Republican re-drawn map aimed at dismantling voter rights in Tennessee.

“I am still in shock that the legendary Lucinda Williams is hosting a concert and fundraiser for us. Now, I’m excited to announce that singer-songwriter Devon Gilfillian will be performing, too! We all agree that Andy Ogles is the wrong choice for the 5th Congressional District. We deserve a Congressperson who will fight for freedom for families first, not the dark money special interest groups that fuel Andy’s campaign.” — Senator Heidi Campbell

And I'm happy to say **IT 'S WORKING**! _We 're seeing more support than EVER before from the community here, and our base is growing every day._

But here's the important part. Right now Cortez Masto is killing us by buying up all the air time, making it impossible for us to keep our ads on the air. | | I am proud to announce my endorsement for re-election by the Human Rights Campaign. HRC is America's largest national lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and queer civil rights organization, and I am committed to working with them to ensure all Americans are treated fairly and equally under the law. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52429760/372201899/1596212816?refcode=2022-10-11-comingoutday&recurring=0&amount=14&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=cf0aed03-a349-ed11-b495-002248258d38&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZjBhZWQwMy1hMzQ5LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CWmmqvIEwdAjESxHnm3SecOP-ZVKir1SU18r7Ytv48w=) Today is National Coming Out Day — a day to celebrate the LGBTQ+ community, and recognize that the act of coming out to friends and family sometimes takes deep personal courage. This National Coming Out Day, I am reminded that while we have made monumental progress towards equal rights, members of the LGBTQ+ community still face significant barriers to equality. **Worse still, MAGA Republicans are openly running on a platform calling to undo what progress we have made.** I am proud to stand with HRC and its millions of members nationwide in fighting for equal rights for members of the LGBTQ+ community. This election, our country faces a fundamental choice. Will we wind the clocks back, or will we continue to work towards the promise of liberty and justice for all? This National Coming Out Day, please join me in celebrating our friends and family in the LGBTQ+ community. **And tomorrow, let us continue fighting for civil and human rights for all.** _Rick_ | clean_body: | | | | I am proud to announce my endorsement for re-election by the Human Rights Campaign. HRC is America's largest national lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and queer civil rights organization, and I am committed to working with them to ensure all Americans are treated fairly and equally under the law. = Today is National Coming Out Day — a day to celebrate the LGBTQ+ community, and recognize that the act of coming out to friends and family sometimes takes deep personal courage. This National Coming Out Day, I am reminded that while we have made monumental progress towards equal rights, members of the LGBTQ+ community still face significant barriers to equality. Worse still, MAGA Republicans are openly running on a platform calling to undo what progress we have made. I am proud to stand with HRC and its millions of members nationwide in fighting for equal rights for members of the LGBTQ+ community. This election, our country faces a fundamental choice. Will we wind the clocks back, or will we continue to work towards the promise of liberty and justice for all? This National Coming Out Day, please join me in celebrating our friends and family in the LGBTQ+ community. And tomorrow, let us continue fighting for civil and human rights for all. name: John Fetterman
subject: I wish I was making this up…
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Seth Moulton for Congress
body:
I wish I was making this up, friend.
But some news came out about Dr. Oz... and I think you’ll probably want to read it for yourself:
http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-fetterman?refcode=221011 [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-fetterman?refcode=221011]
That’s right. During his time at Columbia University, Dr. Oz killed *hundreds* of dogs + an entire litter of PUPPIES!!
You already know me + my team stand firmly on #TeamPuppy. Our pups, Levi + Artie are basically spokesdogs for my campaign.
http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-fetterman?refcode=221011 [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-fetterman?refcode=221011]
Friend, we can’t afford to send a literal puppy killer to the U.S. Senate. Will you split a donation of $15or more between my campaign + Seth Moulton to help us send Dr. Oz back to New Jersey + keep him far, far away from any position of power? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-fetterman?refcode=221011]
Donate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-fetterman?refcode=221011]
Every time we think Dr. Oz couldn’t get worse... he does.
This article said he’s conducted dozens of experimental studies that used live animals as test subjects. When he was at Columbia, he was accused of causing “extensive suffering” to dogs used in his heart experiments.
Dr. Oz has killed HUNDREDS of dogs throughout his career, including an entire litter of puppies. Every day this guy proves he’s just the worst of the worst.
We can’t let Dr. Oz represent PA in the U.S. Senate, friend . Will you split a donation of $15 or more between my campaign + Seth Moulton to help us defeat him this November? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-fetterman?refcode=221011]
I know Gisele, the kids + I will give Levi + Artie a little extra love (and cheese) tonight after hearing this news... and I hope you do the same for your pups too.
Thanks for hearing me out,
John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania

| | INTRODUCTION TO THE NEW NEGOP 2023 LEGISLATIVE PLAN:"GIVE PARENTS CONTROL OVER THEIR CHILDREN’S EDUCATION"
---
| | GIVE PARENTS CONTROL OVER THEIR CHILDREN’S EDUCATION On August 20, 2022, at the SCC meeting, the NEGOP approved the 2023 Legislative Plan for Nebraska, 108th Legislature, 1st Regular Session, 2023. Believing that... “Nebraskans deserve a better and brighter future. They desire policies that put them first instead of policies that stand in their way. The Nebraska Republican Party supports a Legislative plan building a path for a brighter tomorrow. We have full confidence in the potential of Nebraskans to create a future for themselves and their families filled with peace, prosperity, and opportunity.” To that extent, the [2023 Legislative Plan](https://www.ne.gop/so/4aOEpwwZ-/c?w=y8GhxiCOvK0BAXJgKlGB4lucx1vGECPDPUYm6xAeOS0.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubmUuZ29wLzIwMjNsZWdpc2xhdGl2ZXBsYW4iLCJyIjoiYjM4ZmEyZTktYjk2NS00MTNiLWI4MDUtYzM1NmQ2OTczNWZjIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiNDE4YzE3NjEtZWRkMy00YzFhLWIwNjQtYzBiYWM5ZDAyNjRmIn0) consists of seven bullet points to that end. For the next several weeks, these bullet points will bring focus to our platform and values creating messaging opportunities for the NEGOP and our candidates. We want the Republicans of Nebraska equipped with the knowledge of the 2023 Legislative plan and how this plan aligns with the NEGOP Platform “planks”. This plan will be our conservative values put into action towards the goal of influencing policy in our state. Below is the second bullet point we wish to highlight: Legislative Plan 2023 • GIVE PARENTS CONTROL OVER THEIR CHILDREN’S EDUCATION Education should help prepare our children for the rights and responsibilities of citizenship. We have a responsibility to empower Nebraska families with quality education options that nurture our children’s God given talents and strengthen our communities. • Empower parents in selecting the school their child attends by funding school choice • Protect and ensure in all aspects a parent’s fundamental right to raise their children • Give every parent the right to see all curriculum materials in every class their child attends • Encourage schools to teach basic skills that prepare students for life as an adult• Advocate for teaching the truth about America’s history and the ideals of Americanism. NEGOP PLATFORM : [Plank- Education ](https://www.ne.gop/so/4aOEpwwZ-/c?w=Jr66ep3kJ2mAW3MtLMeZxkKbFeij-BW_ycypKKnp7Nk.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubmUuZ29wL2VkdWNhdGlvbiIsInIiOiJiMzhmYTJlOS1iOTY1LTQxM2ItYjgwNS1jMzU2ZDY5NzM1ZmMiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiI0MThjMTc2MS1lZGQzLTRjMWEtYjA2NC1jMGJhYzlkMDI2NGYifQ)The Nebraska Republican Party reaffirms the role of education in the development of effective and responsible citizens. We believe that decisions regarding the education of children properly belong to parents and guardians. We reaffirm our belief that control of all aspects of public education should rest with local school boards, not state or federal agencies. We believe each student should be provided with the opportunity for an excellent academic education. We urge citizens to require fiscal and educational accountability from policy makers, educational institutions, and educational professionals to assure that quality services are being rendered. We support statewide assessments of educational achievement and the administration of the ACT or SAT to all Nebraska 11th-graders. We oppose testing to identify physical, psychological, emotional, or developmental disabilities without parental consent. We recognize and commend the dedicated educators and administrators who strive to prepare the students for future decision making that will directly affect the freedom and security of the United States. We encourage patriotism, respect for the American flag and an understanding of our nation’s ideals, which make our form of government the best in the world. We believe the family to be our country’s basic institution and as such should be encouraged to take a larger, not smaller, role in education. We support parental choice in education based on a program of vouchers or tax credits, thus creating better education through the principles of free market competition. These alternatives should include private, parochial and home schools. We believe that all schools and educators, whether public, private, or home school, be recognized for their contributions to the future of our state. We oppose the instruction of foreign customs and culture, as well as revisionist history, including Sharia law, the 1619 Project and Critical Race Theory in our education system and call on school board members and university regents to strongly resist the use of public schools and finances to teach principles hostile to the founding principles, native customs and legitimate history of the United States. We support the right of parents to personally observe all classroom instruction and activities. We strongly support the teaching of the scientific, biologically verifiable X and Y chromosomal definition of male and female at birth, and the use of locker rooms, sports team qualifications, and restrooms based on the same definition. Nebraskan’s believe our children are our most valuable resource. We believe they deserve the best education from the time they are of school age to the day they graduate. We support parental rights and school choice. We promote the teaching of truth and not the indoctrination of the left. We will fight to defend and protect our youth, and our teachers in the education space. Will you join us in protecting our most valuable resource?

Peter,

Today, the Cherokee, Chickasaw, Muscogee, Choctaw and Seminole Nations came together to announce their official endorsement of my run for governor.

I am honored and humbled to receive this historic endorsement.

The Tribal Nations that call Oklahoma home have built thriving communities, created opportunities and economic prosperity that benefit the entire state, and perhaps most importantly, maintained, celebrated, and shared their cultures with all of us.

From my earliest days running for state superintendent to today, I've had many opportunities to meet with tribal leaders, speak at community meetings, and hear from Native families. Those conversations and connections are why I believe there's a bright future of partnership ahead.

These treasured relationships are also why I firmly oppose Governor Stitt on so many issues -- from tribal sovereignty and school vouchers to healthcare and education -- that will directly impact Native families and communities.

As with so many things, Stitt's approach to collaborating with Tribal Nations seems to be driven by ideology, extremism, and an impulse to turn challenges we can work through together into political fights that push people apart. He's not thinking about what will make Oklahoma better for tribal communities, and the result is more divisiveness and chaos.

The bond we have with the sovereign Tribal Nations is one of Oklahoma’s greatest assets, and something that makes our state entirely unique. As governor, I will strengthen that bond, not break it.

[**If you haven't already, I hope you'll consider joining our growing coalition. With your help, we can bring our state back together and deliver the kind of future that we all deserve and take pride in.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52399506/372151210/-1353800219?refcode=em22_221011_tribalendorsement&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmOTdkYzM0OS04NjQ5LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=583fk8Zjxh0vmK26iogOs54w7fbBvPBeYTRbXXLjKLE=)

clean_body: | Peter, Today, the Cherokee, Chickasaw, Muscogee, Choctaw and Seminole Nations came together to announce their official endorsement of my run for governor. I am honored and humbled to receive this historic endorsement. The Tribal Nations that call Oklahoma home have built thriving communities, created opportunities and economic prosperity that benefit the entire state, and perhaps most importantly, maintained, celebrated, and shared their cultures with all of us. From my earliest days running for state superintendent to today, I've had many opportunities to meet with tribal leaders, speak at community meetings, and hear from Native families. Those conversations and connections are why I believe there's a bright future of partnership ahead. These treasured relationships are also why I firmly oppose Governor Stitt on so many issues -- from tribal sovereignty and school vouchers to healthcare and education -- that will directly impact Native families and communities. As with so many things, Stitt's approach to collaborating with Tribal Nations seems to be driven by ideology, extremism, and an impulse to turn challenges we can work through together into political fights that push people apart. He's not thinking about what will make Oklahoma better for tribal communities, and the result is more divisiveness and chaos. The bond we have with the sovereign Tribal Nations is one of Oklahoma’s greatest assets, and something that makes our state entirely unique. An overwhelming majority of Kentuckians don’t want this -- so we need to

## BOLDUC FOR SENATE ANNOUNCES WOMEN FOR BOLDUC COALITION
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE Contact: Kate Constantini Email: [press@donbolduc.com](mailto:press@donbolduc.com) Manchester, NH – General Don Bolduc, candidate for US Senate in New Hampshire, announced a Women for Bolduc Coalition. This coalition includes nearly 100 women from across the Granite State that are tired of Hassan's voting record and refusal to campaign in the state. Members of the coalition released the following statements: “General Don Bolduc is the only federal candidate with the national defense experience to lead NH and our country during these turbulent national security times. Don Bolduc has what it takes to support our military, defend our borders, and foster productive foreign relations to ensure our country remains a global force for good and fervent protectors of everything we value as Americans. Senator Hassan lacks this experience and this has resulted in more violent domestic crime, a weakened military presence, global show of force from Russia, China, Iran and North Korea, and an out of control border crisis. As a woman who has seen first hand oppression of women in other countries, I want a leader who will fight for national defense to ensure all Americans will enjoy equal protection, free from oppression, and unlimited opportunity. It's time to vote for experience where it counts,” said Lynne Blankenbeker, US Navy Captain (Ret.), Attorney, and Former NH State Representative for Concord. “As Granite Staters continue to struggle to feed their families, we need a US Senator who won't shy away from public debate. Families are feeling the struggle of the policies of the current presidential administration. We cannot keep going down this path and need Don Bolduc to represent us in Washington,” said Maureen Mooney, Nurse and State Representative from Londonderry. “I could not be prouder to be supported by this impressive list of strong women from across the Granite State. Having women leaders in our communities is extremely important and I look forward being a true voice from them in the U.S. Senate and work alongside them to get things done,” said General Don Bolduc. This coalition includes nearly 100 women from across the Granite State that are tired of Hassan's voting record and refusal to campaign in the state. As a woman who has seen first hand oppression of women in other countries, I want a leader who will fight for national defense to ensure all Americans will enjoy equal protection, free from oppression, and unlimited opportunity. It's time to vote for experience where it counts,” said Lynne Blankenbeker, US Navy Captain (Ret.), Attorney, and Former NH State Representative for Concord. “As Granite Staters continue to struggle to feed their families, we need a US Senator who won't shy away from public debate. body:
4 weeks left to win this race...

Hey team, it’s Lauren! There are just 4 weeks left until Election Day on November 8th and we are in full GOTV (get out the vote!) mode. Our mobilization team is working nights, weekends, and around the clock to keep our momentum going. We’re not taking a single vote for granted and there is room for everyone on this campaign. Before we get into it – do me (and Josh) a huge favor and check your voter registration status at [joshshapiro.org/register](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52432653/372212926/747805259?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYzk3NTNiZC1hYTQ5LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jK6_OTHWFk25PiwEfwW4Kwl588OK5AGDcT-CoS2m3sw=&emci=69f3b8ed-e748-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=3c9753bd-aa49-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=21962291). October 24th is the VERY LAST day to register to vote and you can’t get in the game if you’re not registered. Once you check your status, make sure your friends and family are registered too. They’ll thank you later, I promise. The clock is ticking on this election – we have just 28 days until Pennsylvania heads to the polls. Let's win this thing.

Friends —
I gave it all I had on the debate stage last week. Now, voting begins tomorrow in Arizona. That means our window to reach the voters we need is closing.
I’m gonna keep working hard all the way to Election Day, but I’ll be honest: A lot of this depends on you.
This was always going to be one of the most expensive races in the country. But the amount of outside money coming into Arizona to boost Blake Masters and hurt my campaign is shocking — even for me. It feels like another Super PAC or dark money group is announcing another million dollar TV ad every couple days.
And after Masters had his biggest platform yet at our debate last week, we’ve got to be able to set the record straight.
Especially after the NRSC reversed course and has decided to spend an additional SEVEN figures in Arizona between now and the election. It’s a sign that they are all-in on Masters and will do anything to close the gap in these final weeks.
I know I’ve asked a lot, team. But I really need your help, and the ball’s in your court now. If you’ve been waiting to make that first contribution, now is the time. This seat is at risk, and if we don’t hold onto it we’re likely to lose the Senate.

Peter: This is a longer, but especially important, email about why I’m running for Congress to defeat my anti-LGBTQ opponent Chuck Edwards.
It’s also National Coming Out Day so I thought I’d share my coming out story with you and some thoughts on how that connects to this moment and my campaign.
[**I hope after you’re done reading, you’ll chip in $25 or more to ensure we have the resources to fund our organizing work and run a winning campaign.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52402513/372159999/-713949207?refcode=EM_BS_JAS_221011_FR_ComingOutDay_A0_na_U3_X3&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODg4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNDczNmM1Ny04YTQ5LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fVnBSEUapv3GJY_4F2iH-0WbS_fDwK_8Ev2pO37XU6Q=)

---
As an LGBTQ person, you never really stop coming out. Instead, it’s a part of daily life, with countless moments and choices about how you talk about your life, how you dress, how you move through the world.
That’s true for me right now, as we campaign across Western NC, knocking doors, and organizing in parking lots and backyards. The moment I introduce myself and talk about my family – Meghann and our three kids, the four loves of my life – I come out again. Each time, I feel proud and I am also reminded why coming out matters.
When I married Meghann in 2008, our marriage was not legally recognized in North Carolina, or most places in the country. It was a daily reminder to us of the work that needed to happen.
Together, we launched the Campaign for Southern Equality. We were told that what we were doing was unrealistic and that we were reaching way beyond the stars. But with focused action and grit, we kept pushing forward. And finally, marriage equality became legal across all 50 states.
**That’s why on this National Coming Out Day, I’m celebrating all of the progress that’s been made and reflecting on how far we still have to go.**
My extremist opponent Chuck Edwards confirmed in our debate last night that he opposes the freedom to marry. He has spent his time as a state legislator working to pass “Don’t Say Gay” bills. The contrast between us could not be starker.
If we’re going to ensure our laws finally work to fully protect LGBTQ people, then we must stop electing people who oppose equality.
[**We win when we work together. Will you please chip in $25 or more today to our grassroots campaign to help us spread our message and organize across Western NC before Election Day in four weeks?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52402521/372160003/-713949207?refcode=EM_BS_JAS_221011_FR_ComingOutDay_A0_na_U3_X3&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODg4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNDczNmM1Ny04YTQ5LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fVnBSEUapv3GJY_4F2iH-0WbS_fDwK_8Ev2pO37XU6Q=)

---
National Coming Out Day is about celebrating the LGBTQ community. It’s about supporting people who are coming out for the first time. And it’s about recommitting to being brave and strong about working to create a world where things considered “impossible” actually happen.
We’re in this together – always.

If you're able to pitch in, = Peter: This is a longer, but especially important, email about why I’m running for Congress to defeat my anti-LGBTQ opponent Chuck Edwards. It’s also National Coming Out Day so I thought I’d share my coming out story with you and some thoughts on how that connects to this moment and my campaign. = | | = | | = As an LGBTQ person, you never really stop coming out. Instead, it’s a part of daily life, with countless moments and choices about how you talk about your life, how you dress, how you move through the world. That’s true for me right now, as we campaign across Western NC, knocking doors, and organizing in parking lots and backyards. The moment I introduce myself and talk about my family – Meghann and our three kids, the four loves of my life – I come out again. Each time, I feel proud and I am also reminded why coming out matters. When I married Meghann in 2008, our marriage was not legally recognized in North Carolina, or most places in the country. It was a daily reminder to us of the work that needed to happen. Together, we launched the Campaign for Southern Equality. We were told that what we were doing was unrealistic and that we were reaching way beyond the stars. But with focused action and grit, we kept pushing forward. And finally, marriage equality became legal across all 50 states. That’s why on this National Coming Out Day, I’m celebrating all of the progress that’s been made and reflecting on how far we still have to go. My extremist opponent Chuck Edwards confirmed in our debate last night that he opposes the freedom to marry. He has spent his time as a state legislator working to pass “Don’t Say Gay” bills. The contrast between us could not be starker. If we’re going to ensure our laws finally work to fully protect LGBTQ people, then we must stop electing people who oppose equality. = | | = | | = National Coming Out Day is about celebrating the LGBTQ community. It’s about supporting people who are coming out for the first time. And it’s about recommitting to being brave and strong about working to create a world where things considered “impossible” actually happen. subject: Our new podcast launched today!!
body:
| | |
---
**I am so excited to announce the launch of the[ _Innovation Race_ Podcast](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ1OTA4JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/fHcH0SuJXudv55vn7NhIBw) today! ** The subject of patents is not at the top of most Americans’ lists of issues they’re very concerned about – which is exactly how China and Big Tech like it. Unfortunately, because this threat flies under the radar, it allows China to continue their attack by quietly exploiting the weakness in our patent system. But not anymore! This podcast will allow us to continue the story of our newest documentary, _Innovation Race,_ and help us expose the rot inside of the U.S patent protection system. There were just too many stories and too much information to fit into one documentary! [_Innovation Race_ Podcast](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ1OTA4JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/SPlLlFixf31sLn1cIdp0rw) will introduce you to American inventors who had their inventions stolen and patents invalidated by our own government. You will also meet experts who specialize in patent rights, constitutional law, China, national security, venture capital, and intellectual property. **I am so grateful for patriots like you who made it possible for us to produce the documentary, and now this podcast.** You’ve heard the phrase, “Sunshine is the best disinfectant,” and that’s just what Innovation Race Podcast is – a burst of sunshine to show our fellow Americans and elected officials how this threat from China is serious and imminent, and must be solved immediately. **You can[listen to the podcast](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ1OTA4JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/nytwcffyBtye7puE2AZLGQ) on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, Google Podcasts, iHeartRadio, and you can watch it on You Tube, Rumble, and Facebook. ** In the first episode, out today, you’ll hear from Molly Metz, a five-time jump rope world champion who created and patented a jump rope to help her succeed in her craft. Known as the Queen of the Rope, Molly followed all of the protocols to have her ideas and invention patented, only to have her patents “invalidated” by the Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB) – an administrative tribunal that was created by the 2011 America Invents Act that has become a “death panel” for patents. The United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) – the same department that granted her patents – voided them in under 20 minutes, in a review board where there was no jury or ability for Molly to state her case. Now, after spending over half-a-million dollars, Molly continues her fight. [Please join me](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ1OTA4JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/jNmIbjVh_KehQCTmZy4IAg) as I interview these fellow patriots and as we fight to solve this problem before it’s too late! In liberty, Jenny Beth Martin PS: For more details about the film, you can visit the _[**Innovation Race**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)_ website as well.

Peter,

I don’t need to remind you how much is at stake in the coming midterm, but one issue that stands out for me is **health care and protecting our community’s well-being.** I’ve been asked about this quite a bit lately, so I wanted to take a moment to share more about where I stand.
* **Health care needs to be affordable for everyone -- plain and simple.** When we hear stories about IL-17 residents being forced to choose between buying life-saving medication or paying the rent, alarm bells need to go off and we need to see that as a serious problem. That’s where we’re at right now, and in Congress, I won’t just assume Big Pharma will do the right thing. I’ll demand fairness and accountability.

* **Reproductive freedom needs to be protected.** The Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe v. Wade was a grave threat to bodily autonomy. If elected, I will advocate that Congress codify the rights that Roe established.

* **Health care needs to be recognized as an issue of equity.** Times are already tough, and we can’t expect working parents to focus on earning a living when they don’t feel well -- either physically or mentally. We also need to fight discrimination in health care that marginalized groups like the LGBTQ community face.

Today’s GOP has already made it clear where they stand on the issue of health care – less help for those who need it, zero oversight on price gouging, and draconian reproductive laws.

| It starts now, Peter.

Ballots begin arriving to voters this week in San Mateo County, with just under one month to go until Election Day.

Peter, this election is a battle for our climate, economy, democracy, and reproductive freedoms, and it’s absolutely critical that our campaign has the resources to turn out every last CA15 voter before November 8.
[**Can you donate today to help us reach every voter in our district? >>**](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=b144f1f39c&e=292fde286a)
As Assembly Speaker pro Tem, I fought for universal vote-by-mail and automatic voter registration, leading to record voter turnout and participation. With ballots arriving this week, now is the time to make sure that all of your friends, family, and neighbors have a plan to vote. But most importantly, **we want to make sure you are election ready, Peter.**

Any of the following methods will ensure your ballot is counted:
✅Mail-in, postmarked by Nov 8, 2022 📬

body:
Less than one month to Election Day! Here's what you need to know... | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us16.campaign-archive.com/?e=00028e5542&u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=8bdefcf82b)
---
Good afternoon,I hope you are all doing well. We’re less than a month to Election Day and things have never been so promising for a win this November. Just to bring you all up to speed, here are a few quick updates related to the campaign.
[](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=4aa9c6e676&e=00028e5542)
**Hurricane Ian** In the aftermath of Hurricane Ian, we temporarily suspended the campaign to help with maritime search-and-rescue operations in Southwest Florida. During the extensive operations, our team of volunteers made more than 40 civilian rescues, saving people who were trapped in the wreckage of the storm and earning international media attention, including the front page of the Sunday edition of the _New York Times_.I served as the group’s lead boat captain and also aided with search-and-rescues on the ground in Sanibel Island, St. James City, Pine Island, Matlacha, Captiva and more. Additionally, we didn’t just rescue people. We also helped to rescue more than 250 parrots from a bird sanctuary, two lemurs and several dogs and cats.In one case, we established radio communications with a U.S. Coast Guard helicopter to help coordinate the medical evacuation of stranded residents from Sanibel Island. As that was happening, another helicopter flew over to my boat and signaled that a nearby boat full of rescuers was also in distress. We raced to that boat, towed them safely back to shore, and provided them with a spare anchor. We then returned to the other rescue. See the Associated Press’s story about our rescues [here](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=5207da6762&e=00028e5542).The campaign has now resumed, but please continue to support and pray for our neighbors in SWFL.
[](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=8aa35152aa&e=00028e5542)
**We won our first general election straw poll** Here’s some promising news! The straw poll conducted by the Riverview Chamber of Commerce shows me leading Democrat incumbent Kathy Castor by nearly five points. In the poll, we led by a margin of 52.63 percent to 47.37 percent.The poll accurately reflects other predicted similar poll results in two other Florida statewide races. It shows Sen. Marco Rubio (R-FL) leading Rep. Val Demmings (D-FL) in the state’s U.S. Senate race, with Rubio ahead by a margin of 51.28 percent to Demings’s 46.15 percent.The Riverview Chamber poll also shows Republican Laurel Lee handily beating her Democrat opponent in Florida’s 15th Congressional District, as expected.
[](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=5eed02768f&e=00028e5542)
**Kathy Castor Agrees to Debate** Last week at a community forum in St. Petersburg, Castor verbally agreed to participate in a debate with me. She said she would be happy to debate anytime, however, so far Castor has not followed through with her promise.After telling our campaign to call her office to schedule the debate, her team has not returned our calls for a debate.
# I STILL NEED YOUR HELP!
As the election environment continues to improve, and our chances of winning look more promising, please consider helping my campaign by making a contribution, volunteering or by placing a sign in your yard. We need money to get the word out. Please help today!
| [DONATE NOW](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=959a1c846a&e=00028e5542)

body:
Dear Friends,

With your help, Democrats have governed For The People by growing our economy with record jobs numbers, lower health costs, unprecedented investments in our infrastructure and future – with minimal to no help from Republicans.

Less than 4 weeks to November 8th, Democrats are on a path to victory that ran from Kansas to New York to Alaska and across our nation.
On Wednesday, join me and my Special Guest, DCCC Chair Sean Patrick Maloney to talk about DEMOCRATS’ PLAN TO WIN: GROWING OUR ECONOMY, DEFENDING OUR FREEDOMS.

RSVP here for our Zoom on Wednesday, October 12th at 1pm PT / 4pm ET (**note the special time**):

https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/1016437740912/WN_Hi7GYH9RTl-cdAcD9bOkAQ

Chairman Maloney is a leader in the Congress and on our national battlefield. Representing New York’s Hudson Valley, Chairman Maloney knows first-hand what it takes to win a tough race in a competitive district.

He brings that battle-tested perspective and a plan to keep our Democratic House Majority.

In the House, Rep. Maloney serves on the Intelligence, Agriculture, and Transportation & Infrastructure Committees. He never stops fighting and delivering for Hudson Valley working families like the one he grew up in and the one he has built with his husband Randy and their three children. As the first openly gay Congressman from New York, Congressman Maloney knows how important it is to make the Equality Act the law of the land, once and for all, and to secure the rights and freedoms of all Americans.

Thank you all for your support of our House Democrats! Together with our VIPs - our Volunteers in Politics - we are bringing leverage to America’s working families and defending everyone’s freedoms.

I look forward to you joining me and Chairman Maloney to discuss our plan to win. Along with our volunteers in politics and activists, Democratic field office headquarters that are working hard on the ground in our Frontline and Red to Blue battleground districts across the country to defend our Democratic House Majority will be tuning in as well!

Make sure that you are following me on Twitter at https://twitter.com/TeamPelosi for updates of our work to bring home a great Democratic Victory – together!

NANCY

As the top Democrat in the House, she's fighting to help working families and protect America from the dangerous agenda of Mitch McConnell and Kevin McCarthy.
We know you're getting a lot of emails -- but it's only because what we're facing right now as a country is so important.

Thank you for fighting by my side every step of the way in this race – through all the victories and setbacks.
Thank you for helping me give Marco Rubio the toughest fight of his career.
And now I'll be up-front about where we stand: I'm _1 point_ down in recent polls, and once again I'm counting on this powerful grassroots team to help with the resources I need to pull ahead in these final weeks.

The student loan crisis has made one thing absolutely clear, Michael... The American dream can't **_ONLY _**run through college. Private, business and government dollars have been poured into higher education, and the cost of a degree has skyrocketed for students. In Maryland, we've focused on creating non-college career opportunities, reducing the cost of college, and cutting the degree requirement for many state jobs. We need more of this across the country. **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

He's tough and smart – and has a strong and long record of winning fights for the people of Ohio. The latest polling shows Tim and JD Vance neck and neck – and these final weeks are crucial. A Democratic WIN in Ohio would go far in denying Mitch McConnell the Senate majority. This Ohio seat that Republican Rob Portman is retiring from has been in GOP hands for 24 years! That's just one reason why national Republicans are pulling out all the stops trying to buy this seat for JD Vance. They've spent a record-breaking $30 million attacking Tim with vicious smear campaigns – and just last week Donald Trump’s new MAGA pack launched another $1 million attack ad campaign. And the dark money keeps rolling in to influence votes in these final weeks before the election. = =** There’s still time left to make an impact on this race. The countdown to the general election starts today.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20221011-3488-header&t=1&akid=3488%2E2526796%2Eu5Lry_)
We’re officially 28 days from the midterm election.
Alexandria is facing off with a MAGA Republican opponent who attended Donald Trump’s rally in Washington that preceded the January 6 siege of the Capitol.
Last year, our Republican opponent raised $10 million against us, and this year our opponent is hosting $500 per plate fundraising dinners across the country in order to fund their disinformation campaign against us.
**How are these MAGA Republican candidates able to raise so much money against Alexandria when our district leans so Democratic?** Because for the MAGA crowd, winning this race isn’t the point. They use the campaign as an opportunity to attack and discredit Alexandria and the values she stands for. They want to spread disinformation and lies that weaken our democracy and hurt the policies we’re fighting for.
Just a few weeks ago, our opponent’s campaign set up a massive #OustAOC sign on a highway overpass in Queens. She also held a rally against immigrants at a site where buses were dropping off asylum seekers from Texas to New York.

Fellow American,

**The Radical Left never seems to learn their lesson.**

Last year, Democrats took their attacks to Twitter, calling me _“Uncle Tim”_ in reference to an anti-slavery novel written in 1852 that is often used to demean Black people.

I wasn’t mad or infuriated; I was more disappointed than anything. It’s one thing to negatively attack my policies, **but to attack me based on my skin color is just wrong.**

clean_body: Disappointing... but not surprising | | Peter, every House Democrat recently voted against legislation requiring a school to have informed parental consent regarding sexual orientation or gender identity. The Democrats agenda is nothing short of insanity and a blatant attack on parental rights. Before the vote, Governor Glenn Youngkin, said, “kids don’t belong to the state” and that “important decisions must involve parents.” I couldn’t agree more. I’ve been proud to work with Governor Youngkin in the State Senate to ensure parents have a say in their kids' education and I look forward to carrying his message to Washington to protect parents, children, and families. | This might be the best example of why we need to regain a majority in the House. On day one in Congress, Republicans will move to pass the Parents' Bill of Right which will recover lost learning from school closures, and expand parental choice so over a million students can receive the education their parents know is best. We cannot let the Left drown out parents’ voices in decisions involving their own children. I hope you’ll join me in stopping them. | With gratitude, Jen PAID FOR BY KIGGANS FOR CONGRESS Kiggans for Congress, P.O. Box 5042, Virginia Beach, VA 23471

#

**My Fellow Patriot, ** **I served this great nation in the US Navy because I felt the call to serve this country and fight for the principles that make America the greatest country on this EARTH.** **It’s been reported that Veteran representation in Congress is at a RECORD LOW! I’m running because we need more Veterans who UNDERSTAND PUBLIC SERVICE. Politicians of today think We The People serve them; Well, guess what, they're WRONG!** [**Unlike them, I HAVE YOU! Chip in NOW- $25, $50, $100!**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=8e59885a22&e=3cd8121505) **As a Navy Combat Veteran, I served this country and the American people. Now I’m running for Congress to serve again!** **While the Left works to destroy our free speech, right to bear arms, and civil liberties, I’m organizing a grassroots campaign team like NEVER SEEN BEFORE.** **The Left is SCARED and is pumping dark money into my opponent's campaign. LIKE CRAZY! I need your help; I need reinforcements. I’m tired of We The People being neglected by those in office with the privilege of serving us.********They have a sense of political entitlement that is truly sick and wrong. **
[**HELP LEON TAKE BACK AMERICA!**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=38fe242bf5&e=3cd8121505) **My name is Leon Benjamin, and I’m running for Congress as a Conservative Republican... because I’m sick of what the far Left has done to my community and to American families. I’m a husband, father, and pastor. I owe it to my congregation and my family to build a better future. These days we need to fight for them even to have a future.** [**Help me beat the special interests, the Soros money, and WIN- $50, $150, $250!**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=e3fc69e60f&e=3cd8121505) **I didn't serve this country to see it burned to the ground by BLM anarchists or tassel loafer-wearing government bureaucrats. I served to defend our constitution. Defend our liberties. Defend our people, or die trying.**
[**HELP LEON SERVE THE PEOPLE!**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=9f70517cc9&e=3cd8121505) **I’m a Navy Combat Veteran, Small Business Owner, and Senior Pastor and Bishop at my church. I even helped create President Trump’s Faith-Based Initiative back in 2016.** **My opponent is a radical leftist who’s voted to strip law-abiding Americans, voted for the election overthrow HR-1, gun control, socialism, mass amnesty, and so much more. His actions to trample our constitution, destroy American values and suppress We The People’s voice is unacceptable. **

[**DONATE TO TAKE BACK THE HOUSE!**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=db95e0568d&e=3cd8121505) **I appreciate your support; my team said I need to come up with $15,000 by the end of this month to help secure our media and radio slots to win the general. ** [**DONATE NOW!**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=ffbbeef541&e=3cd8121505) [**$25**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=7301d65378&e=3cd8121505) [**$50**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=467698f4c0&e=3cd8121505) [**$75**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=4bfd864780&e=3cd8121505) [**$100**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=a01040e89b&e=3cd8121505)
**God bless you, your families, and God bless America. The country we know, love, and must protect. ** **Your Friend in Christ,**

Leon Benjamin ****
