**About Jim Jordan:** | Leading the fight to hold Washington accountable.

**Jordan helped found and was elected by his colleagues to chair the House Freedom Caucus. Jordan is focused on his oversight role, helping lead investigations into federal agencies, including the IRS.**

In Congress, Jim Jordan continued to fight for fiscal responsibility, authoring the “Cut, Cap and Balance” plan get the country’s finances back on track. As a budget committee member he offered more spending cuts than any other Member of Congress, and as RSC Budget/Spending Task Force Chairman, he offered the only balanced budget of any member of the House or Senate.

As a state legislator, he took on the powerful special interests and the leaders from both political parties who wanted to put Ohio on an unsustainable path of higher taxes and spending.

**Greg Abbott** | **_Nearly_ $25 million**

2. **But here’s the bad news: we didn’t raise enough to outweigh all the money Greg Abbott has in the bank.** In order to win, we have to immediately pick up our pace. Remember, Greg Abbott started with a huge cash advantage. He’s dramatically outspent us (2.5x on TV and radio ads!).

| | Good news, Derek, Our latest victories in the Senate – The CHIPS Act and the Inflation Reduction Act – are going to do big things for America. The CHIPS Act means that the manufacturing of semiconductors will happen within the United States, instead of in other countries, allowing us to lead the way in the production of technology. name: Candace Owens
subject: White Lives Matter
body:
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601790:6VjZg4V-N:m:1:3317145305:6EFD5B5FAF58D5FE28FDFA6B40E20B56:r)

Peter,

Wow. I broke the internet by posing with Kanye West wearing "White Lives Matter" shirts.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601790:6VjZg4V-N:m:1:3317145305:6EFD5B5FAF58D5FE28FDFA6B40E20B56:r)

"Why?" you may ask.

As Kanye West said, "I perform for an audience of one - and that's God." We all matter. We should not be divided. We need to come together and not allow radical groups and the media to divide us.

Kanye West also said "Utopia is possible for not who we are being led by." I'm tired of pretending that radical groups like BLM are helping Black and urban communities.

I'm on a personal mission to bring pro-Family, pro-Freedom, and pro-Faith values to Black and urban communities. That's why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

[_**Can I count on you to support your fellow Americans and the BLEXIT Foundation with a gift of $25, $50, $100, $500, $1,000 or any amount? Click here to send your donation >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601790:6VjZg4V-N:m:1:3317145305:6EFD5B5FAF58D5FE28FDFA6B40E20B56:r)

Here are the facts that no one in the media want to talk about when it comes to Black communities:

**No one wants to talk about the 117,626 Black children who were killed by surgical abortion in 2018. 20 MILLION Black babies aborted in total.

Obesity is the number one killer in America and Black women have the highest rates of obesity. 56.9% are obese. But no one talks about it.

No one wants to talk about Black on Black crime. According to CDC, Black Americans are 4x more likely to be killed by homicide than anyone else. And what NO ONE wants to say is Black Americans account for 40% of homicide offenders.

No one wants to talk about the failing Black education. 74% of Black boys in California could not pass a basic reading comprehension test.**

The Establishment is dividing America by gender, race, politics, and belief systems. They would rather us focus on criminals like George Floyd than discussing the real issues hurting Black communities.

In 2020, only 9 unarmed Black men were killed by police. How does that compare to the numbers above?

[_**Please consider supporting BLEXIT Foundation with a gift of $25, $50, or any amount? Click here to send your donation >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601790:6VjZg4V-N:m:1:3317145305:6EFD5B5FAF58D5FE28FDFA6B40E20B56:r)

[_**Donate $25 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601791:6VjZg4V-N:m:1:3317145305:6EFD5B5FAF58D5FE28FDFA6B40E20B56:r)

[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601797:6VjZg4V-N:m:1:3317145305:6EFD5B5FAF58D5FE28FDFA6B40E20B56:r)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601798:6VjZg4V-N:m:1:3317145305:6EFD5B5FAF58D5FE28FDFA6B40E20B56:r)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601790:6VjZg4V-N:m:1:3317145305:6EFD5B5FAF58D5FE28FDFA6B40E20B56:r)

Kanye shared a great message from his creative director about this.

_**" One needs to have courage and persistence to truly assume their identity and who they really are. Every day becomes a battlefield to defend this unique identity."**_

This is a feeling I know all too well. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. This message is heartbreaking, and I still face that today.

It's the message the media pushes on Black and minority communities.

_We 're told we're victims, nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and that racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. _

This is simply not true.

BLEXIT is showing how a pro-Family, pro-Faith, and pro-Freedom mindset can lift up Black and urban communities. **Our message is about UNITING people -_that means all people_ \- not division. **

[_**Your support empowers, awakens, and inspires millions of minorities to pursue the American dream and shape their own futures. Please send your generous gift today and help them find their BLEXIT >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601790:6VjZg4V-N:m:1:3317145305:6EFD5B5FAF58D5FE28FDFA6B40E20B56:r)

**Here 's how BLEXIT Foundation is helping.**

Peter, BLEXIT State Chapters are the hands and feet of our Foundation. That's why I've set a goal to raise $50,000 this month to support our state chapters.

**BLEXIT Chapters provide opportunities for people to engage with their communities through social engagement, educational activities, community service, and virtual events.**

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice** : Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

[_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601790:6VjZg4V-N:m:1:3317145305:6EFD5B5FAF58D5FE28FDFA6B40E20B56:r)

* **Pro-police Criminal Justice Reform** : The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601790:6VjZg4V-N:m:1:3317145305:6EFD5B5FAF58D5FE28FDFA6B40E20B56:r)

* **Entrepreneurship** : I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

[_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601790:6VjZg4V-N:m:1:3317145305:6EFD5B5FAF58D5FE28FDFA6B40E20B56:r)

* Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

[_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601790:6VjZg4V-N:m:1:3317145305:6EFD5B5FAF58D5FE28FDFA6B40E20B56:r)

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message.

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

**Peter, can you help the next generation have the courage to stand up for their beliefs? Click below to donate.**

[_**Donate $25 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601791:6VjZg4V-N:m:1:3317145305:6EFD5B5FAF58D5FE28FDFA6B40E20B56:r)

[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601794:6VjZg4V-N:m:1:3317145305:6EFD5B5FAF58D5FE28FDFA6B40E20B56:r)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601795:6VjZg4V-N:m:1:3317145305:6EFD5B5FAF58D5FE28FDFA6B40E20B56:r)

Thank you,

Candace Owens
Co-Founder & President
BLEXIT Foundation

The deadline for registering to vote in Texas is today!
Visit VoteTexas.org and make sure you and all the Texans you know are prepared to make your voices heard in this year’s elections. [https://www.votetexas.gov/register-to-vote/index.html?emci=de448417-2b23-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=90a97c57-3023-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=29495980]
There’s less than a month left to talk to Texans about our race in TX-07 and other important races on the ballot, and #TeamLizzie volunteers are working hard to get out the vote. Lizzie was glad to join them to stamp postcards at our postcard-writing party hosted by Run Sister Run PAC and helped kick off an Alief-area block walk with Swing Left. Sign up to join #TeamLizzie today! [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221011wu?refcode=lpfe221011wu [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221011wu?refcode=lpfe221011wu]

Another easy way you can help expand our reach in the district is by getting a #TeamLizzie yard sign. You can pick one up at any time at #TeamLizzie HQ (2990 Richmond Ave.) or request to have one delivered to you. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lfc20-yardsigns]
Lizzie recently received a couple of exciting endorsements from the Houston Chronicle and the Alliance for Retired Americans!
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221011wu?refcode=lpfe221011wu [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221011wu?refcode=lpfe221011wu]
The Houston Chronicle endorsed [https://www.houstonchronicle.com/opinion/endorsements/article/Editorial-We-recommend-Lizzie-Fletcher-for-the-17485478.php] Lizzie for re-election, recognizing the way she works across the aisle to deliver on Texas priorities — including her efforts to protect access to out-of-state abortion care.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221011wu?refcode=lpfe221011wu [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221011wu?refcode=lpfe221011wu]
Lizzie has a 100% score from the Alliance for Retired Americans for her track record in Congress as a champion for seniors and retirees and her efforts to protect critical earned benefits like Social Security and Medicare.
October is National Disability Employment Awareness Month, and we wanted to make sure you heard about a bill Lizzie is spearheading that would help disabled veterans get to work.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221011wu?refcode=lpfe221011wu [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221011wu?refcode=lpfe221011wu]
In Houston — which has the second largest veteran population in the country — vehicles are essential for getting around, including to jobs, interviews, and job-training opportunities. If signed into law, Lizzie’s bill would give disabled veterans the chance to update outdated adaptations to their vehicles for their medical needs if their disabilities prevent them from driving. The House passed the bill recently, putting it one step closer to becoming law and helping disabled veterans across Texas and our country.
Thanks for being a part of the team,
Team Lizzie

[] Lizzie has a 100% score from the Alliance for Retired Americans for her track record in Congress as a champion for seniors and retirees and her efforts to protect critical earned benefits like Social Security and Medicare. October is National Disability Employment Awareness Month, and we wanted to make sure you heard about a bill Lizzie is spearheading that would help disabled veterans get to work. [] In Houston — which has the second largest veteran population in the country — vehicles are essential for getting around, including to jobs, interviews, and job-training opportunities. If signed into law, Lizzie’s bill would give disabled veterans the chance to update outdated adaptations to their vehicles for their medical needs if their disabilities prevent them from driving. The House passed the bill recently, putting it one step closer to becoming law and helping disabled veterans across Texas and our country. Here are three things you need to know today.
1. We have 28 days until Election Day and early voting is already underway in a handful of states.
2. Republicans need to flip 5 seats to take back the House and 1 seat to take back the Senate.
3. Republicans are being outraised in battleground races across the country, and funds are running critically low.

[**If you have anything to spare, I am humbly asking you to rush in a donation of any amount today. Right now, Republican majorities in both the House and the Senate are within our grasp, but only if everyone does their part. The most competitive elections could come down to a handful of votes, making immediate funding in these final moments so important. I’m hoping I can count on you to step up with a donation right away during this final stretch. Fellow American,

For nearly 15 years and throughout this Senate campaign, I've been forthcoming about the mental health challenges that I struggled with in the past. I have overcome a lot in my life - self-confidence issues, a stutter, and thanks to the help of mental health professionals, dissociative personality disorder.

I even wrote a book in 2008, called _Breaking Free_ , about the trials I have faced in my life. On top of my efforts to be transparent with mental health issues, I regularly encourage those facing mental health challenges themselves - including our troops and veterans - to seek the help they need to overcome them.

**But apparently my efforts to get treatment, make amends, and help others with similar struggles is not enough in the eyes of Raphael Warnock, who has run millions in false and misleading attack ads to tear me down.**

clean_body: I’ve recorded a rebuttal to Raphael Warnock’s misleading television ads. Please take a look: | Fellow American, For nearly 15 years and throughout this Senate campaign, I've been forthcoming about the mental health challenges that I struggled with in the past. I have overcome a lot in my life - self-confidence issues, a stutter, and thanks to the help of mental health professionals, dissociative personality disorder. I even wrote a book in 2008, called Breaking Free , about the trials I have faced in my life. On top of my efforts to be transparent with mental health issues, I regularly encourage those facing mental health challenges themselves - including our troops and veterans - to seek the help they need to overcome them. But apparently my efforts to get treatment, make amends, and help others with similar struggles is not enough in the eyes of Raphael Warnock, who has run millions in false and misleading attack ads to tear me down. We know we make a big deal out of these official deadlines, so we wanted to take a moment to explain why this final FEC deadline is so important to Cheri Beasley’s chances.
#

Next week is the final FEC fundraising deadline before Election Day. We know we make a big deal out of these official deadlines, so we wanted to take a moment to explain why this final FEC deadline is so important to Cheri Beasley’s chances.
After this FEC deadline, candidates who are on the ballot in November are required to report how much money they’ve raised. Right now, our opponent and his super PAC allies don’t know what we’ve raised. And we don’t know what he’s raised either.
But we know that they are going to have a close eye on this report to look for any signs of vulnerability. Inside Elections recently said “Republicans had hoped to put this race away over the summer,” but we fought back hard and this race remains statistically tied.
McConnell and National Republicans are extremely nervous about this race, so if we look vulnerable now, they could try to dump an absurd amount of money into North Carolina on a moment’s notice to take advantage of that.
That’s why this deadline is so important — strategically and practically. Every campaign, national group, and super PAC will look at these reports and make some of their final spending decisions — including us.
So, we have to raise everything we can and exceed our fundraising goals so we’re prepared to organize everywhere in the final few weeks of the campaign. And since messages like this are the number one source of donations to our campaign, we need to ask:

name: Candace Owens
subject: White Lives Matter
body:
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601360:6lkcs5VAN:m:1:3331421248:9B1145FA5E6739A1F378325235860C91:r)

Peter,

Wow. I broke the internet by posing with Kanye West wearing "White Lives Matter" shirts.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601360:6lkcs5VAN:m:1:3331421248:9B1145FA5E6739A1F378325235860C91:r)

"Why?" you may ask.

As Kanye West said, "I perform for an audience of one - and that's God." We all matter. We should not be divided. We need to come together and not allow radical groups and the media to divide us.

Kanye West also said "Utopia is possible for not who we are being led by." I'm tired of pretending that radical groups like BLM are helping Black and urban communities.

I'm on a personal mission to bring pro-Family, pro-Freedom, and pro-Faith values to Black and urban communities. That's why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

[_**Can I count on you to support your fellow Americans and the BLEXIT Foundation with a gift of $25, $50, $100, $500, $1,000 or any amount? Click here to send your donation >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601360:6lkcs5VAN:m:1:3331421248:9B1145FA5E6739A1F378325235860C91:r)

Here are the facts that no one in the media want to talk about when it comes to Black communities:

**No one wants to talk about the 117,626 Black children who were killed by surgical abortion in 2018. 20 MILLION Black babies aborted in total.

Obesity is the number one killer in America and Black women have the highest rates of obesity. 56.9% are obese. But no one talks about it.

No one wants to talk about Black on Black crime. According to CDC, Black Americans are 4x more likely to be killed by homicide than anyone else. And what NO ONE wants to say is Black Americans account for 40% of homicide offenders.

No one wants to talk about the failing Black education. 74% of Black boys in California could not pass a basic reading comprehension test.**

The Establishment is dividing America by gender, race, politics, and belief systems. They would rather us focus on criminals like George Floyd than discussing the real issues hurting Black communities.

In 2020, only 9 unarmed Black men were killed by police. How does that compare to the numbers above?

[_**Please consider supporting BLEXIT Foundation with a gift of $25, $50, or any amount? Click here to send your donation >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601360:6lkcs5VAN:m:1:3331421248:9B1145FA5E6739A1F378325235860C91:r)

[_**Donate $25 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601361:6lkcs5VAN:m:1:3331421248:9B1145FA5E6739A1F378325235860C91:r)

[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601364:6lkcs5VAN:m:1:3331421248:9B1145FA5E6739A1F378325235860C91:r)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601365:6lkcs5VAN:m:1:3331421248:9B1145FA5E6739A1F378325235860C91:r)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601366:6lkcs5VAN:m:1:3331421248:9B1145FA5E6739A1F378325235860C91:r)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601367:6lkcs5VAN:m:1:3331421248:9B1145FA5E6739A1F378325235860C91:r)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601368:6lkcs5VAN:m:1:3331421248:9B1145FA5E6739A1F378325235860C91:r)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601360:6lkcs5VAN:m:1:3331421248:9B1145FA5E6739A1F378325235860C91:r)

Kanye shared a great message from his creative director about this.

_**" One needs to have courage and persistence to truly assume their identity and who they really are. Every day becomes a battlefield to defend this unique identity."**_

This is a feeling I know all too well. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. This message is heartbreaking, and I still face that today.

It's the message the media pushes on Black and minority communities.

_We 're told we're victims, nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and that racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. _

This is simply not true.

BLEXIT is showing how a pro-Family, pro-Faith, and pro-Freedom mindset can lift up Black and urban communities. **Our message is about UNITING people -_that means all people_ \- not division. **

[_**Your support empowers, awakens, and inspires millions of minorities to pursue the American dream and shape their own futures. Please send your generous gift today and help them find their BLEXIT >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601360:6lkcs5VAN:m:1:3331421248:9B1145FA5E6739A1F378325235860C91:r)

**Here 's how BLEXIT Foundation is helping.**

Peter, BLEXIT State Chapters are the hands and feet of our Foundation. That's why I've set a goal to raise $50,000 this month to support our state chapters.

**BLEXIT Chapters provide opportunities for people to engage with their communities through social engagement, educational activities, community service, and virtual events.**

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice** : Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

[_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601360:6lkcs5VAN:m:1:3331421248:9B1145FA5E6739A1F378325235860C91:r)

* **Pro-police Criminal Justice Reform** : The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601360:6lkcs5VAN:m:1:3331421248:9B1145FA5E6739A1F378325235860C91:r)

* **Entrepreneurship** : I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

[_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601360:6lkcs5VAN:m:1:3331421248:9B1145FA5E6739A1F378325235860C91:r)

* Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

[_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601360:6lkcs5VAN:m:1:3331421248:9B1145FA5E6739A1F378325235860C91:r)

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message.

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

**Peter, can you help the next generation have the courage to stand up for their beliefs? Click below to donate.**

[_**Donate $25 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601361:6lkcs5VAN:m:1:3331421248:9B1145FA5E6739A1F378325235860C91:r)

[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601363:6lkcs5VAN:m:1:3331421248:9B1145FA5E6739A1F378325235860C91:r)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601364:6lkcs5VAN:m:1:3331421248:9B1145FA5E6739A1F378325235860C91:r)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601365:6lkcs5VAN:m:1:3331421248:9B1145FA5E6739A1F378325235860C91:r)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601366:6lkcs5VAN:m:1:3331421248:9B1145FA5E6739A1F378325235860C91:r)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601367:6lkcs5VAN:m:1:3331421248:9B1145FA5E6739A1F378325235860C91:r)

Thank you,

Candace Owens
Co-Founder & President
BLEXIT Foundation

name: Kevin (Personal)
subject: Bottom of the 9th
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McCarthy for Congress
body:
You're up

| |
---
| | |
---

Hi Peter, GOP Leader Kevin McCarthy here.

Picture this...

After 8 grueling innings of the most intense pitchers' duel you can remember, your arch rivals hit a solo homer off your closer in the top of the 9th. The half inning ends, but the damage has been done. You're down by one going into the bottom of the 9th.

One baserunner and two outs later, you step into the batter's box as your team's last remaining hope...

We're officially in the bottom of the 9th of the election cycle and Pelosi has pitched Republicans into this exact spot.

Friend, About a month ago, the current Republican administration abruptly announced that 8,411 households will completely lose their assistance by December 1st. **** I’ve been an advocate for better housing policy my entire life, and I am devastated by the administration’s announcement. Due to this decision, many Vermonters will have nowhere to go and no net to catch them in a state where there is just over a 2% vacancy rate. **** Unlike the current administration, I have your back. In order to solve our housing crisis, we must create a plan that meets Vermont’s needs. It must address all Vermonters, from those experiencing homelessness to middle income families. **** As governor, I promise I will ensure that Vermonters have access to emergency, transitional, and permanent housing, including in the rental market and home ownership. I will address zoning and systemic barriers. No Vermonter will be left behind.
Vermont needs a governor who stands alongside the most vulnerable instead of leaving them to risk freezing to death. In order to keep building momentum in our campaign, we must continue show up strongly in this filing deadline tomorrow at midnight. clean_body: | | Friend, About a month ago, the current Republican administration abruptly announced that 8,411 households will completely lose their assistance by December 1st. ** I’ve been an advocate for better housing policy my entire life, and I am devastated by the administration’s announcement. Due to this decision, many Vermonters will have nowhere to go and no net to catch them in a state where there is just over a 2% vacancy rate. Unlike the current administration, I have your back. In order to solve our housing crisis, we must create a plan that meets Vermont’s needs. It must address all Vermonters, from those experiencing homelessness to middle income families. ** As governor, I promise I will ensure that Vermonters have access to emergency, transitional, and permanent housing, including in the rental market and home ownership. I will address zoning and systemic barriers. No Vermonter will be left behind. Vermont needs a governor who stands alongside the most vulnerable instead of leaving them to risk freezing to death. In order to keep building momentum in our campaign, we must continue show up strongly in this filing deadline tomorrow at midnight. Fellow American,

For nearly 15 years and throughout this Senate campaign, I've been forthcoming about the mental health challenges that I struggled with in the past. I have overcome a lot in my life - self-confidence issues, a stutter, and thanks to the help of mental health professionals, dissociative personality disorder.

I even wrote a book in 2008, called _Breaking Free_ , about the trials I have faced in my life. On top of my efforts to be transparent with mental health issues, I regularly encourage those facing mental health challenges themselves - including our troops and veterans - to seek the help they need to overcome them.

**But apparently my efforts to get treatment, make amends, and help others with similar struggles is not enough in the eyes of Raphael Warnock, who has run millions in false and misleading attack ads to tear me down.**

We've launched a rebuttal ad to his nasty, dishonest campaign that helps set the record straight, **[but I need your help expanding where it is airing on TV, Fellow American. clean_body: I’ve recorded a rebuttal to Raphael Warnock’s misleading television ads. Please take a look: | Fellow American, For nearly 15 years and throughout this Senate campaign, I've been forthcoming about the mental health challenges that I struggled with in the past. I have overcome a lot in my life - self-confidence issues, a stutter, and thanks to the help of mental health professionals, dissociative personality disorder. I even wrote a book in 2008, called Breaking Free , about the trials I have faced in my life. On top of my efforts to be transparent with mental health issues, I regularly encourage those facing mental health challenges themselves - including our troops and veterans - to seek the help they need to overcome them. But apparently my efforts to get treatment, make amends, and help others with similar struggles is not enough in the eyes of Raphael Warnock, who has run millions in false and misleading attack ads to tear me down. We've launched a rebuttal ad to his nasty, dishonest campaign that helps set the record straight, I'm a Christian who is saved by grace. I believe in redemption, and I trust the voters of Georgia do too. Thank you for standing with me, Herschel Walker | | PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC. Don't want to receive any more of our emails? Peter,

I’m going to keep this brief. You’ve been a top supporter and you know what’s on the line.

body:
With a month to go until the election, we are working hard each and every day to make sure we take our campaign message to voters across California. | | |
---
| | Dear Peter ,

With a month to go until the election, we are working hard each and every day to make sure we take our campaign message to voters across California.

**_One thing is clear: Safety and Security is a message understood in every community, neighborhood, and language._**

Just take the haunting statistic that under Rob Bonta, hate crimes are up 33% compared to the previous year. Hate crimes against Asian Americans increased by almost 178%! Bonta's response to this crisis has been entirely inadequate.

_**No one should feel unsafe due to the color of their skin, the religion they practice, or the language they speak.**_

That is why my campaign has made a concerted effort to reach people where they are, in the language that they speak. Check out some of our efforts by visiting our outreach websites in [Chinese](https://strategyinsightshq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=634ddc357d96a36fb118fa25c&id=42566838ed&e=94837ebab3), [Vietnamese](https://strategyinsightshq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=634ddc357d96a36fb118fa25c&id=c27209daef&e=94837ebab3), [Korean](https://strategyinsightshq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=634ddc357d96a36fb118fa25c&id=a44e0c7a50&e=94837ebab3), [Punjabi](https://strategyinsightshq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=634ddc357d96a36fb118fa25c&id=b4ddf894d4&e=94837ebab3), and [Spanish](https://strategyinsightshq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=634ddc357d96a36fb118fa25c&id=d3894f8ae4&e=94837ebab3).

This past week, I toured some of the diverse communities of California in Sacramento, Yuba City, San Francisco, San Jose, Selma, Westminster, Los Angeles, and San Diego, explaining my belief that hate has no place in our beautiful state and those that act on hate will be brought to justice.
---
|
---
---
|
---

body:
Right now we’re laser-focused on our campaign strategy and our path to victory in the next 28 days.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=1056%2E61531%2E32xmRo)
Hi there,
It’s Ryan again, Peter Welch’s campaign manager. It’s hard to believe, but we only have four weeks left until Election Day in Vermont! We’re so excited for this final stretch, and today I’d like to share our next campaign update that you can expect every Tuesday until Election Day.
Right now we’re laser-focused on our campaign strategy and our path to victory in the next 28 days. In a moment, I’m going to lay out everything—where we stand right now, our plan to elect Peter, and what we need to make it happen—[**but I know it’s pretty long, so if you don’t have time to read through it all right now, will you please make a donation?**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4588?t=3&akid=1056%2E61531%2E32xmRo)
**The Landscape in Vermont**
Many people think the race to replace Senator Leahy in the U.S. Senate is a safe race for Democrats. How could a Republican win in Bernie Sanders’ home state? The fact is: at least one Republican already has. We currently have a Republican governor who was elected with 68% of the vote. **It’s not that hard to imagine another Republican winning here, especially in a midterm year.**
Vermont has a long history of a strong independent streak—Patrick Leahy is the only Democratic Senator we’ve ever had. So we can’t take anything for granted, no matter what the talking heads may say.
A few other important points to remember:
* Republicans only need to win ONE Senate seat to win back the majority. We can’t afford to let it be Vermont.
* Our opponent already surprised many by coming out of nowhere to win the Republican primary against a better-funded candidate with more national and institutional support. He’s eager to do it again.
* A recent poll showed Peter winning by only 6 points—indicating that our lead has narrowed significantly.
* Fox News, Breitbart, and other national Republicans are now actively covering our race as competitive. The right is energized and mobilized around this race.

For these reasons and more—we are not taking anything for granted. We are going to be working our butts off, from now through November 8, to make sure we elect Peter Welch to be our next U.S. Senator for Vermont. **[(If you’re convinced, you can chip in to support us right now.)](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4588?t=4&akid=1056%2E61531%2E32xmRo) **
The stakes are too high to take it easy. The future of our progressive agenda—everything from protecting reproductive freedom, to combating climate change, to lowering costs for working people—depends on our success.
So here’s an overview of our plan to win—and why we need your support.
**Team Welch’s Plan to Win**
**1) Meet with Vermonters all across the state and ask for their vote**
* We’re organizing across the state to talk to as many voters as possible. That means volunteers talking to their friends and neighbors, on the phones and at their doors.
* [**Sign up to join the team here.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/volunteer?source=em_20221011_f_r_memo_natl&t=5&akid=1056%2E61531%2E32xmRo)
* We’re organizing collaboratively with other Democratic campaigns up and down the ballot, because winning a more progressive future doesn’t stop with a U.S. Senate seat.
* We recently launched our Welch Wagon 14 County Tour to make sure Peter and our team visit every county in the state. We’ve already been to three counties—keep an eye out for updates.
* **We’ve collected thousands of endorsements from grassroots supporters because this campaign really is people-powered.[ If you haven’t already, you can add your name to our list of endorsers. ](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-endorsement/?source=em_20221011_f_r_memo_natl&t=6&akid=1056%2E61531%2E32xmRo)**

**2) Make sure people hear the truth about Peter’s record of service**
* In today’s era of misinformation and hyperpartisanship, it’s important that voters hear the facts about Peter’s record of bipartisanship and service. We’re raising the resources needed to get our message out on the airwaves, online, in mailboxes, and on the doors.
* We’re reminding voters that Peter has a record of delivering results. We’re proud to share how Peter has delivered investments in job creation, lowered costs on prescription drugs AND energy bills, combatted climate change, supported our veterans, shored up Vermont’s roads and infrastructure, and more. Vermonters know Peter is more focused on solutions than politics.
* We’re not accepting any donations from Corporate PACs, so we rely on this grassroots team to fund our work and to get our message out. You can [**donate**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4588?t=7&akid=1056%2E61531%2E32xmRo) or [**sign up to volunteer**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/volunteer?source=em_20221011_f_r_memo_natl&t=8&akid=1056%2E61531%2E32xmRo) to help right now.

**3) Stay focused on Vermont Priorities**
* Peter knows he has to earn the trust of Vermonters every day. Our work on the campaign will always reflect Peter’s commitment to all Vermonters and all of Vermont.
* We’re staying focused on the issues that matter most by listening to Vermonters, and making plans to meet those needs once Peter gets to the Senate.
* Everywhere he goes, Peter is asking Vermonters about the issues that matter to them:
* Protecting reproductive freedom
* Lowering costs, including Rx costs
* Combating climate change
* Protecting democracy
* Increasing affordable housing
* [**You can tell us what’s on your mind here, any time.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/survey/em-issues-survey-2022/?source=em_20221011_f_r_memo_natl&t=9&akid=1056%2E61531%2E32xmRo)

Let’s get it done!
Ryan McLaren
Campaign Manager, Welch for Vermont

Peter, New article from _The Federalist_ about the 2022 Election... and how the **GOP Establishment is refusing to help candidates** in close races like Doug’s.
Here’s the highlights about Doug’s campaign: **The GOP is Leaving Key Gubernatorial Candidates Out to Dry**
> In Pennsylvania, where Republican Doug Mastriano is going head-to-head with Democrat Josh Shapiro, **[the Republican Governors Association] has yet to offer any significant support for Mastriano’s campaign...** ...unlike**Shapiro, who has received roughly _5.1 million_** between early June and mid-September from the Democratic Governors Association...
The article also makes clear what we already know: **you are the one fueling our campaign,_not_ deep-pocketed Republican Elites:**
>
> **Nearly $420,000 of the $3.1 million** [Mastriano] raised in the past three months were from **contributions of $250 or less.**

You, me, and Doug all joined this fight for the same reason: to **take America back from _both_ the Far-Left and the corrupt Establishment forces **that spent decades selling us out.
